plugins.readme_text:
# @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

**English** | [中文](#中文)

> Edit the user-global instructions file (`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`) from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings UI — no need to open the `.dsh` folder by hand.

> Based on [couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt) (MIT, © couplingartist); this repository fixes its packaging so the plugin actually installs, and continues the work.

![Settings page](assets/global-prompt-settings-page.png)

## What you get

| Situation | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Settings → **全局指令** (Global instructions) | A new settings section: multiline editor + Save button + file path + character count |
| First save | Creates `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` if it does not exist (UTF-8, no BOM) |
| Single source of truth | The settings page reads/writes the same file external editors do — no second copy |
| Effect timing | Follows the harness's touch-driven reload: new sessions read the latest content immediately; open sessions re-read on their next successful file tool call or turn |
| Security | The HTTP API answers loopback (127.0.0.1) only; request bodies capped at 1 MiB |

## What this fork fixes

As published, upstream could never be installed from GitHub or npm:

| Defect (upstream) | Fix (here) |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/` gitignored, no `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` installs an empty shell (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) | Prebuilt `lib/` is committed, and `prepack` rebuilds before `npm publish` |
| The npm name `dsh-global-prompt` belongs to an unrelated project | Published as `@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt` |
| Peers pinned to `0.1.1-rc.2` → dsh 0.2.x rejects the install | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` ranges `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` + `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` lists modules that no longer exist in the shell | Now lists `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` (verified against the 0.2.0-rc.2 frozen module table) |
| Client bundle id hardcoded to the old name; source map leaks local paths | Registers under the full package id; source maps disabled |
| No LICENSE / CHANGELOG / engines | Added (MIT) |

## Install

```powershell
# npm (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile web add @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

# or straight from GitHub (works because lib/ is committed)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-global-prompt
```

Restart the web instance so the new plugin loads:

```powershell
dsh web
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` → Settings → **全局指令**. (Adjust `--profile web` to the profile you actually run.)

## Uninstall

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
dsh web
```

## Development

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm test         # vitest: store (13) + editor (7)
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build        # lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (client bundle)
```

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `src/store.ts` | Seam 1: read/write semantics of the user-global instructions file (unit-tested) |
| `src/index.ts` | Host plugin: registers `GET/PUT /api/global-prompt` |
| `src/client/GlobalPromptEditor.tsx` | Seam 2: the editor component (unit-tested) |
| `src/client/api.ts` | HTTP implementation of the editor IO boundary |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Client plugin: registers the `settings.section` entry |
| `tsdown.config.ts` | Build: ESM host lib + CJS client factory wrapped in `__ModuleLoader__.load` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle layer: inserts the `global-prompt` row |

## License & credits

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Original work by **couplingartist** ([dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)); packaging, compatibility and maintenance fixes by **HelloQingTao**.

---

# 中文

**[English](#zfgctadsh-global-prompt)** | 中文

> 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 设置界面里直接编辑**用户全局指令文件**（`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`），不必再手动打开 `.dsh` 目录改文件。

> 基于 [couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)（MIT，© couplingartist）；本仓库修复了它的打包问题使其真正可安装，并继续维护。

![设置页](assets/global-prompt-settings-page.png)

## 你会得到什么

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 设置 → **全局指令** | 新增一个设置分区页：多行编辑器 + 保存按钮 + 文件路径显示 + 字符数统计 |
| 首次保存 | 文件不存在时自动创建 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`（UTF-8 无 BOM） |
| 唯一真源 | 设置页与外部编辑器读写同一份文件，没有第二份数据 |
| 生效时机 | 遵循系统触摸驱动刷新：新会话立即读到最新内容；已打开会话在下一次成功文件工具调用或新一轮时重新读取 |
| 安全 | HTTP 接口仅允许本机回环（127.0.0.1）访问；请求体上限 1 MiB |

## 本仓库修复了什么

上游原版按它发布的样子在 GitHub / npm 上根本装不上：

| 缺陷（上游） | 修复（本仓库） |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/` 被 gitignore 且没有 `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` 装出来是空壳（`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`） | 预构建的 `lib/` 直接入库，并在 `npm publish` 前用 `prepack` 重新构建 |
| npm 上的 `dsh-global-prompt` 包名属于另一个无关项目 | 改名发布为 `@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt` |
| peer 钉死 `0.1.1-rc.2` → 被 dsh 0.2.x 拒装 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 改为范围 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，并声明 `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` 引用了外壳里已不存在的模块 | 改为 0.2.0-rc.2 冻结模块表实际存在的 `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` |
| 客户端 bundle id 硬编码旧名；sourcemap 泄漏本地路径 | 按完整包名注册；关闭 sourcemap |
| 缺 LICENSE / CHANGELOG / engines | 已补齐（MIT） |

## 安装

```powershell
# npm（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

# 或者直接从 GitHub 安装（lib/ 已入库，开箱即用）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-global-prompt
```

重启 web 实例使新插件生效：

```powershell
dsh web
```

然后打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` → 设置 → **全局指令**。（`--profile web` 请换成你实际使用的 profile。）

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
dsh web
```

## 开发

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm test         # vitest：store（13）+ editor（7）
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build        # lib/index.js（宿主半）+ lib/client.js（客户端 bundle）
```

| 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/store.ts` | 接缝 1：用户全局指令文件的读写语义（单测覆盖） |
| `src/index.ts` | Host 插件：注册 `GET/PUT /api/global-prompt` |
| `src/client/GlobalPromptEditor.tsx` | 接缝 2：编辑器组件（单测覆盖） |
| `src/client/api.ts` | 编辑器 IO 边界的 HTTP 实现 |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Client 插件：注册 `settings.section` 分区 |
| `tsdown.config.ts` | 构建：ESM 宿主 lib + 包在 `__ModuleLoader__.load` 里的 CJS 客户端工厂 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：插入 `global-prompt` 行 |

## 许可与致谢

MIT — 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。原作者 **couplingartist**（[dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)）；打包、兼容性与维护修复来自 **HelloQingTao**。

# dsh-mc-gradle-runner

**在 DeepSeek Harness 里一键跑 Minecraft 的 `runClient` / `runData`，并且让模型自己会用。**

写 Minecraft 模组最烦的两件事：改完代码要切回 IDEA 点运行，数据生成完了要自己 `git diff` 看产物变了什么。这个插件把这两件事都搬进 DSH：

- 聊天窗口**右上角多出一组 run\* 按钮**，长得和 IDEA 的运行按钮一个习惯——不用切窗口，点一下就跑；
- 模型**自己也能起任务**，跑完 `runData` 会**自动把产物 diff 摆到你面前**，跑了 `runClient` 如果崩了会**把崩溃报告摘要递过来**。

对任意 Gradle 的 MC 项目都能用：Forge、NeoForge、Fabric Loom、Architectury，单模块、多模块 monorepo 都行。不绑定某个仓库。

---

## 它长什么样

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ◀ 会话     ▣ CTNH-Core - Client ▾  ▶  ■  ⋮   ▶ 1:24  │  ← 右上角，排在所有控件最左边
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

版式照着 IDEA 的运行工具条来：

| 控件 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **▣ Client ▾** | 运行配置选择器。列出这个项目里所有 run\* 任务（多模块项目会带 `模块 - 类型` 名字），也可以在这里从 Gradle 刷新任务清单 |
| **▶ 绿键** | 跑当前选中的配置。**跑过一次就变成循环箭头 ⟳**，表示再点是"重新运行"；取消过一次则退回三角 |
| **■ 红键** | 停止。**真的停干净**——连 Gradle daemon 拉起的游戏进程一起带走 |
| **⋮** | 更多操作：重开日志面板、从 Gradle 刷新任务列表、看项目根与来源 |
| **▶ 1:24** | 有任务时贴一行状态：运行中（带耗时）/ 完成 / 失败 / 已取消 |

按钮**只在认出这是个 MC 项目时才出现**。打开一个普通的 Java 库、或压根不是 Gradle 的目录，界面上什么都不会多——不会有一排点不动的假按钮。

点绿键之后，右侧栏会**自动开一个日志页签**，输出实时滚进来；同一个会话始终复用一个页签，不会越跑越多。

### 为什么停止按钮值得单说

默认的 `gradlew runClient` 会把构建交给一个**长命 Gradle daemon**，而 daemon 随后会被系统重新挂到别的父进程下。结果是：游戏进程**根本不在你启动的那个进程树里**，`taskkill /T` 够不到它，你点了关闭，游戏窗口还留在那儿。

这个插件默认加 `--no-daemon`，让整条链（wrapper → java → 游戏）都在自己的进程树内，关闭就是真关闭。实测对比（同一套项目，只差这一个参数）：

| | 游戏在进程树内 | 点关闭后游戏还活着 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 默认 | ❌ | **是** |
| `--no-daemon` | ✅ | 否 |

代价是每次冷启动一个 JVM——对本来就要跑几十秒的 MC 项目来说可以忽略。想换回去就改 `daemonMode`。

---

## 装

需要 DeepSeek Harness（desktop profile）与一个能跑的 Gradle MC 项目。

打开 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，在「包名或地址」输入框里粘贴仓库地址：

```
https://github.com/mmyddd/dsh-mc-gradle-runner
```

点安装即可。装好之后：

- 会话头部右上角出现 run* 按钮（只在真正的 MC 项目里出现）；
- 设置 →「插件配置」→ `dsh-mc-gradle-runner` 里出现本插件的开关。

升级同样在插件管理里操作，重新拉一次这个地址就行。

> 开发时想让改源码立刻生效，就把插件目录换成 junction 指到本地仓库，
> 别用 pnpm 的 `file:` 依赖——它会**拷贝**一份，之后你改的代码不会同步，
> 会被"明明改了却没生效"坑很久（这个坑我踩过）。

---

## 用

### 手动：点按钮

打开任意会话，右上角就有。第一次点 `Client` 之前的探测要几百毫秒。

### 右侧栏的实时日志

点绿键就会自动把右侧栏的日志页签打开，`gradlew` 的输出边跑边进。它不只是"看"：

- **运行中自动跟随**（你手动往上滚就不抢你的滚动条）；
- **彩色分档**：普通构建输出、失败行、Gradle 的进度噪声视觉上能分开；
- 跑完把 `runData` 的产物 diff、`runClient` 的崩溃摘要直接贴在日志下面；
- 底部有**命令输入框**，`runClient` 和 `runServer` 都能用。

**命令怎么进游戏——分两段。** 第一段是把面板的管道接到游戏进程：Gradle 的 `JavaExec` 默认**不转发标准输入**，插件启动时用 `-I` 注入自带的初始化脚本（`lib/stdin-init.gradle`），给所有 `JavaExec` 接上 `standardInput = System.in`。不改你的构建脚本，任何 MC 项目都能用，关掉 `forwardStdin` 就退化成纯日志。

第二段才是关键：**光转发没用，客户端根本不读 stdin**。Minecraft 1.20.1 源码里全库只有 `DedicatedServer` 一处读 `System.in`（服务端控制台线程，Forge 再套一层 JLine 的 `TerminalHandler`）；`net/minecraft/client/**` 下**没有任何一处**读 stdin——字节到了游戏 JVM 也会原地消失。所以插件在 `runClient` 上再挂一个 `-javaagent`（`lib/console-bridge/`），由它在游戏 JVM 里补上缺失的读线程：

- 以 `/` 开头 → `ClientPacketListener.sendCommand`（如 `/time set day`）
- 其余 → `sendChat`（发一条聊天消息）
- 全程只用反射、不 import 任何 Minecraft 类，因此不绑定 MC 版本与映射（Mojmap / SRG 名字都认）；类从 `Instrumentation.getAllLoadedClasses()` 里找，能跨 NeoForge 的转换类加载器
- 游戏还没启动完就敲了命令不会丢——桥会等客户端实例，先排队的命令随后执行

执行回执打在日志里，形如 `[mc-console] 已交给客户端：time set day` / `[mc-console] 尚未进入世界，命令无处执行`。看到回执才代表真的进了游戏。

> 这条链路依赖 `--no-daemon`：长命 daemon 的 `System.in` 不是我们这条管道。
> 所以把 `daemonMode` 改成 `daemon` 之后，命令输入框基本就没用了。

**服务端不挂桥**：`runServer` 本来就有 JLine 在读同一个 stdin，再挂一个读者只会两边抢行、命令随机丢一半。

**桥的 jar 是随插件发布的**（`lib/console-bridge/mc-console-bridge.jar`，约 6 KB）。万一你的安装里缺了它，输入框会被明确禁用并提示怎么补，而不是敲完回车弹一句"已发送"、实际什么都没发生。自己编译：`node lib/console-bridge/build.mjs`（需要 JDK 17+，会自动找 `JAVA_HOME` 或 PATH 里的 `javac`）。

### 让模型来：`mc_run_*` 工具

```
你：帮我把数据重新生成一下，看看产物变了什么
```

模型会调 `mc_run_task { kind: "data" }`，后台跑，跑完自动拿到 diff——**而且它看到的就是你能看到的那张 diff 卡片**。

五个工具：

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `mc_run_task` | 起任务。`kind` 可以是 `client` / `data` / `server`，也可以直接给完整任务名如 `:modules:CTPP:runClient` |
| `mc_run_output` | 读输出。`wait: true` 就阻塞等它跑完 |
| `mc_run_list` | 现在有哪些任务在跑 |
| `mc_run_kill` | 停掉 |
| `mc_send_command` | 往正在跑的游戏里发一行：`/` 开头按命令执行（如 `/time set day`），其余按聊天发送 |

`mc_send_command` 是日志面板底部那个输入框的模型侧等价物，所以它同样只对 `runClient` / `runServer` 成立。它写完会短暂等一等游戏侧的回执并一起返回；没等到回执时它只会说"还没确认"，不会替你断言命令生效了——原因见上面那段"命令怎么进游戏"。

**工作区确实是可运行的 MC 项目时**（判定与"是否显示按钮"完全同一套：有 Gradle 构建脚本且发现了 `run*` 任务），插件还会往系统提示词里加一小段，告诉模型这几个工具怎么配合、以及"发送成功 ≠ 执行成功"。工作区不对时那段话不会出现，模型也就不会去调注定失败的工具。

任务全程在后台，**不阻塞前台**——你在它跑的时候还能继续聊。

**不想让模型碰这些？** 在设置里把「向模型暴露工具」关掉，按钮照常能用。

### `runData` 之后你会看到什么

不是干巴巴一句"文件变了"，而是三层：

1. **总量** —— 新增 3、修改 7、删除 1
2. **按类目分组** —— `lang` / `recipes` / `tags` / `models` / `loot` …… 一眼看出这次动的是哪块
3. **逐个文件** —— 带**真实增删行数**（`+4/-2`）和实际改动内容，不是笼统的行数对比

底下还垫了一条 `git status` 补充来源，产物目录之外的手改文件也不会漏。

### `runClient` 崩了

不用去翻日志。插件会认出崩溃报告，把**路径 + 描述 + 异常 + 栈顶 + 可疑 mod** 一起交出来。模型直接就能开始分析，而不是对着"退出码 1"发呆。

---

## 认路径这件事

多模块 MC 项目里"哪个才是可运行的目标"经常没那么显然。插件的发现来源**按可信度分级**：

```
Gradle 自己报的任务清单  >  IDEA 运行配置(.run/)  >  IDEA 项目结构(.idea/)  >  自己解析 settings.gradle
```

不硬编码任何路径。它读你项目里已有的 `gradlew` / `settings.gradle` / `.idea` / `.run`，所以不管你是上百个子模块的大整合包，还是自己写的小模组，都能自己找对地方。

顺带一个实际遇到过的问题：有些项目里子模块**自带一份只声明 `pluginManagement` 的 `settings.gradle`**，朴素的"往上找最近的 settings.gradle"会停在那儿、把任务名的 `:modules:XXX:` 前缀丢掉。这里改用**打分**（有 wrapper、settings 里有 `include`、有 build 脚本）再取分最高且最靠上的那个目录，就不会被带偏。

---

## 设置

在 **设置 → 插件配置 → dsh-mc-gradle-runner** 里改，改完即时生效，不用重启。

最常用的几个：

| 开关 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启用插件 | 开 | 总闸。关掉后按钮和工具都不出现 |
| 显示快捷按钮 | 开 | 右上角那组 run\* 按钮 |
| 向模型暴露工具 | 开 | 关掉后模型看不到 `mc_run_*`，按钮照常 |
| Gradle daemon | `no-daemon` | 改成 `daemon` 启动更快，但关闭按钮会留下游戏进程 |
| 同名任务策略 | `reject` | 已在跑同名任务时：拒绝 / 复用 / 替换 / 允许并存 |
| Gradle 根目录 | 自动 | 需要时手动指定 |
| 每个 diff 展示的行数 | 40 | 嫌 diff 太长就调小 |

<details>
<summary>全部 20 个配置项</summary>

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `showButtons` | `true` | 是否显示快捷按钮 |
| `exposeTools` | `true` | 是否把工具暴露给模型 |
| `enabledTools` | 全部 | 只暴露列出的工具 |
| `gradleRoot` | 自动发现 | 强制指定 Gradle 根 |
| `daemonMode` | `no-daemon` | `no-daemon` / `daemon` |
| `duplicatePolicy` | `reject` | 同名任务并发策略 |
| `allowGradleTaskQuery` | `true` | 允许从菜单触发 `gradlew tasks`（一次约 7–9 秒，会缓存） |
| `dataDirs` | 内置四路径 | 产物目录覆盖 |
| `maxDiffFiles` | `40` | diff 最多展开的文件数 |
| `diffHunkLines` | `40` | 每个文件展示多少行改动 |
| `diffMaxBytes` | `524288` | 单文件参与 diff 的字节上限 |
| `snapshotTextBudgetBytes` | `67108864` | 快照保留旧内容的累计上限（64 MB） |
| `outputLimitBytes` | `4194304` | 单任务内存输出上限 |
| `dataTimeoutMs` | `120000` | runData 后收集 diff 的等待上限 |
| `taskQueryCacheMs` | `300000` | 任务清单缓存时长 |
| `taskQueryTimeoutMs` | `180000` | 任务清单查询超时 |
| `gitBin` | `git` | git 可执行文件 |
| `forwardStdin` | `true` | 用 `-I` 注入脚本把 stdin 转发给游戏 JVM；关掉则控制台命令到不了游戏（输入框会明确禁用并说明是这个开关） |
| `buttonOrder` | `-100` | 按钮排序，越小越靠左 |

</details>

---

## 出问题的时候

| 现象 | 大概是什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 右上角没有按钮 | 当前会话的工作目录不在 MC 项目里。或插件被总闸关了 |
| 按钮在、点了没反应 | 多半是 wrapper 找不到——结果里会说明，并提示 PATH 上的 `gradle` |
| 右侧栏没有日志页签 | 页签在**点绿键之后**才创建；也可以从 `⋮` 菜单里手动「打开日志面板」 |
| 命令输进去了游戏没反应 | `forwardStdin` 被关了，或 `daemonMode` 改成了 `daemon`；也可能是项目自己覆盖了 `standardInput` |
| 关了任务游戏还在 | 检查 `daemonMode` 是不是被改成了 `daemon` |
| `runData` 说"没有产物变更" | 数据生成结果真的和启动前一致。也可能产物目录不在默认四个路径里，用 `dataDirs` 指定 |
| 崩了但没给报告 | 插件只认"新写出来的"报告——目录里堆着的历史崩溃不会被翻出来当成本次的 |
| 任务在跑，又点了一次 | 默认拒绝并告诉你已有的任务 id，改 `duplicatePolicy` 可换行为 |
| 改了插件源码没生效 | 装的是拷贝而不是 junction。见上面安装说明 |

---

## 开发

```powershell
cd C:\Git\dsh-mc-gradle-runner
node test/run-all.mjs          # 全部用例
node test/run-all.mjs client   # 只跑名字含 "client" 的
```

用例在 `test/`，每个文件独立进程跑，互不影响。包含几条真跑 Gradle 的端到端链路：造一个真会崩的 `runClient` 验证崩溃摘要、造一个真改文件的 `runData` 验证 diff 内容正确性、造一条父子进程链验证关闭按钮能把孙子进程也带走。

`test/test-discovery.mjs`、`test-gradle-e2e.mjs`、`test-gradle-paths.mjs` 需要一个**真实的** MC 项目才跑得起来，没给路径时打印 `SKIP` 跳过（这是设计如此，不是失败）：

```powershell
node test/test-discovery.mjs C:\path\to\your\mc\project
# 或设环境变量，三个脚本都会用
$env:MC_TEST_PROJECT = 'C:\path\to\your\mc\project'
node test/run-all.mjs
```

源码在 `lib/`：`index.js`（主机半身：工具 + API 路由）、`client.js`（浏览器半身：工具栏 + 日志页签 + 设置页）、`discovery.js`（项目与目标发现）、`proc.js`（进程与任务注册表）、`diff.js`（产物快照与 diff）、`crash.js`（崩溃报告识别）、`bridge.js`（控制台桥的定位与"这个任务能不能发命令"的判定）、`command.js`（发送命令：选哪个任务写、回执归谁）、`guidance.js`（提示词里那段 MC 工具说明的文案）、`prompt.js`（把那段说明挂进系统提示词，带按 cwd 的短缓存）、`stdin-init.gradle`（注入给 JavaExec 的 stdin 转发 + javaagent 挂载脚本）、`console-bridge/`（游戏 JVM 里的读 stdin 代理：`ConsoleBridge.java` 源码、`build.mjs` 编

plugins.description: DSH 原生 SkillX 插件：从会话提取可复用能力，支持契约化调用、版本管理与自动恢复。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH SkillX 插件

这个插件把 DSH 会话中的成功执行提取成可复用的 SkillX 能力。SkillX 保留 Skill 的“按需发现”方式，但把可重复任务固化为带输入输出 Schema、版本、依赖、执行记录和恢复机制的黑盒能力。

插件运行在 DSH 内，复用 DSH 的 Agent、会话、工具、Skill Provider、PTC 运行时、模型配置、凭据、权限和会话记录。

## SkillX 在 DSH 插件中的应用

典型路径是：先由 Agent 完成一次代表性任务，再从该会话提取 SkillX。后续类似任务启用 skillx 后，模型只需要发现能力、读取契约、填充输入并调用 `capability_run`；内部步骤由插件按已发布版本执行。

```text
成功会话
→ 证据快照
→ DSH 提取 Agent
→ 契约校验与版本发布
→ 模型通过 capability_run 调用
→ 输出校验、回执和恢复
```

SkillX 对普通 Skill 的改进：

| 维度 | 普通 Skill | SkillX |
|---|---|---|
| 使用方式 | 模型读取说明后自行规划 | 模型读取契约后调用黑盒能力 |
| 上下文成本 | 容易加载长文档和参考资料 | 只暴露名称、说明和 Schema |
| 稳定性 | 每次重新选择工具和步骤 | 固定已验证执行路径 |
| 输出质量 | 依赖模型自检 | 输出必须通过 Schema 校验 |
| 版本治理 | 说明和脚本容易漂移 | 不可变修订、版本锁和依赖闭包 |
| 失败处理 | 调用方继续排查 | 插件分类失败、前台恢复、后台维护 |

## 测试效果

### DeepSeek Flash High

2026-10-14 的三轮对照使用 DeepSeek Flash High，任务为本地 commit、创建模拟 MR、合并 MR、回读核验。

| 指标 | 未启用 skillx | 启用 skillx | 变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 平均耗时 | 74.583 秒 | 51.381 秒 | 减少 31.11% |
| 平均会话 Token | 244,280 | 139,644 | 减少 42.83% |
| 平均模型调用 | 10.333 次 | 6.333 次 | 减少 38.71% |

完整测试归档见 [docs/tests/2026-10-14](docs/tests/2026-10-14/README.md)。这组结果是小样本描述性对照，适合说明固定、多工具、可验证任务启用 skillx 后的收益来源。

### GPT-5.5 medium

2026-10-18 的三组对照使用 GPT-5.5 medium，复用同一已提取工作流，任务为创建分支、提交指定文件、推送到本机远端并创建模拟 MR。

| 指标 | 未启用 skillx | 启用 skillx | 变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 平均耗时 | 74.378 秒 | 16.742 秒 | 减少 77.49% |
| 平均会话 Token | 221,273 | 68,366.667 | 减少 69.10% |
| 平均模型调用 | 7.333 次 | 3 次 | 减少 59.09% |
| 模拟交付成功率 | 3/3 | 3/3 | — |

六次调用的提交范围、正文和 MR 结果均正确。启用组完整应用指定 PATH 前缀；关闭组三次均遗漏该参数，在实验环境中仍能完成交付。工作流内部每次执行六个工具步骤，耗时 0.719～1.053 秒，模型 Token 为 0。

GPT-5.5 medium 的单次从零提取样本耗时 127.348 秒、166,044 Token，自动完成验收与发布。逐轮数据、提取成本及实验条件见 [GPT-5.5 实验归档](docs/tests/2026-10-18/README.md)。Token 均包含报告的缓存读取；两批实验分别用于各自条件下的启用与关闭对照。

## 安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zaoweiceng/dsh-skillx-workflow.git
cd dsh-skillx-workflow
./scripts/install.sh
./scripts/start.sh --no-open
```

使用已安装的 `dsh`，默认接入 `web` profile、端口 3080。可设置 `DSH_BIN`、`DSH_PROFILE` 和 `DSH_SKILLX_PORT`。已在运行的 DSH 应由其原启动方式重启。

## 使用与边界

- SkillX 默认打开首页；在 SkillX / 工作流选项卡为条目打开“在首页展示”，即可通过首页卡片直接进入参数调用界面。展示选择持久保存，独立于能力启用状态，优化版本后保留。首页说明最多显示 80 个字符，悬停查看全文；选项卡右侧的“编辑”开启卡片拖动排序，顺序自动保存（也可用 Alt + 左右方向键排序）。
- 左侧 SkillX 管理面板使用 DSH React 组件，每条能力可启用或关闭。
- 会话操作菜单可从所选会话提取 SkillX；插件会创建 DSH Agent 读取证据。
- 提取 Agent 通过专属工具提交候选，验收通过且成功结束后才发布。草稿可续跑和按字段局部修复，后续请求集中提供当前草稿、相关失败与必要契约；预算采用可调整的工作估计。详见[提取草稿与预算](docs/operation.md#提取草稿与预算)。
- 优化支持同时选择最多 8 条执行会话；新的 DSH Agent 先看逐步耗时、用量索引，再分页读取完整证据，并根据原版本完成优化。优化成功后以新修订发布。
- 调用方通过 DSH `skill` 工具获取功能及输入/输出契约，再调用 `capability_run`。实现与依赖正文留在插件内部，由 DSH Agent 生成可执行定义，通过宿主 PTC 运行；可组合固定版本的能力和内部推理调用。
- 执行失败先分类：内部问题在同次调用内由 DSH Agent 恢复，外部阻塞返回精简原因。输出必须通过契约验证；详细步骤、错误与用量保留在私有执行记录中。
- 前台 `timeoutMs` 覆盖执行与当前任务恢复；到期停止业务执行并保留证据。后台能力维护使用独立生命周期和预算，基于记录诊断并交由新的 DSH Agent 优化定义。后台任务持久记录状态与关联会话。
- 同名能力优先于普通 Skill。历史执行证据记录来源和观察条件，Agent 根据当前状态判断可复用的验证结果。
- 在 SkillX 面板的“提取模型”选项卡配置提取与优化模型，默认使用 DSH DeepSeek Flash 的 Low 推理档位。各阶段使用任务启动时的配置，并记录实际模型与用量。执行中的推理、恢复与后台诊断沿用调用方配置；提供方和凭据由宿主管理。

## 开发与验证

`npm test` 运行 `tests/` 下的插件测试。`npm pack --dry-run` 检查发布白名单。

- `src/`：Agent、执行、恢复、存储与证据处理。
- `client/`：DSH 网页端插件入口。
- `tests/`：宿主集成与单元验证。
- `scripts/`：安装、启动与运行检查。
- `docs/`：SkillX 概念、契约、插件设计、运行机制和测试归档。

配置 `enableCapabilities` 控制模型侧能力发现，管理和手动提取界面独立提供。测试使用现有模型的 endpoint、名称和凭据引用。

架构、能力契约、执行恢复与开发说明见 [文档索引](docs/README.md)。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)。DSH 及其他依赖遵循各自许可证。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：批量删除/归档对话记录，支持删除未分组的对话。A DeepSeek Harness plugin to batch delete & archive conversations, including ungrouped ones.
plugins.readme_text:
# deepseek-harness-session-cleaner

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 增加一个「删除对话」侧栏面板的插件：可以勾选并删除**任意**对话记录——包括**未分组的对话**（默认工作区 / 无工作区的对话）。官方界面只能删除工作区、归档对话，不能删除对话本身，这个插件补上了这个缺口。

## 功能

- 侧栏底部新增「删除对话」垃圾桶图标 → 打开面板
- 列出所有对话：标题、所属工作区或「未分组」标签、轮数、大小、最后活动时间、归档 / 置顶 / 运行中 / 已打开状态
- 搜索、筛选（全部 / 未分组 / 已归档 / 使用中）、多选、全选
- 批量删除或逐条删除（两步确认，防误删）；点击标题可直接打开对话
- 「归档」替代方案：不想彻底删除的对话先归档（隐藏，可找回）
- 正在打开 / 运行的对话默认不允许删除（有提示）；勾选「同时删除正在运行的对话」可强制删除
- 中英双语、自适应明暗主题

## 为什么选它（优势）

- 🎯 **专治「未分组对话」**：官方界面和多数同类插件只覆盖工作区内的对话，本插件把默认工作区 / 无工作区的对话也完整列出、可勾选删除
- 🔒 **误删保护**：删除必须两步确认；正在打开 / 运行的对话默认拒绝删除（可勾选强制）
- 📦 **批量操作**：多选、全选、批量删除、批量归档，配搜索和筛选
- 🗂️ **归档安全网**：拿不准的先归档（隐藏、可找回），确认后再彻底删除
- 🔄 **删除干净彻底**：同时清理磁盘日志、投影缓存与工作区登记，侧栏即时刷新，不留残影
- 🇨🇳 **完整中文**：界面与文档全中文（英文可用），自适应明暗主题
- 🧪 **真实环境验证**：隔离环境端到端测试 + 真实 desktop 配置验证
- 🚫 **不碰你的文件**：只删对话记录本身，附件和工作区目录里的文件原样保留

## 安装

在 **DeepSeek Harness 完全退出**后执行（Windows 可双击仓库里的 `install-session-cleaner.cmd`，或手动执行）：

```bat
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "file:<本仓库路径>"
```

然后重新启动 DeepSeek Harness，侧栏底部（设置图标上方）出现垃圾桶图标。

> 也可以装到 `web` 配置：把命令中的 `desktop` 换成 `web`。

**卸载**（完全退出后）：

```bat
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-session-cleaner
```

## 工作原理

插件是一个包（host + 浏览器两个半边）：

- **Host 半边**（`lib/index.js`）在应用 Web 服务器上注册三个接口：
  - `GET /api/session-cleaner/sessions` — 汇总会话持久化、工作区注册表、投影缓存，返回全部对话
  - `POST /api/session-cleaner/delete` — 删除：移除会话磁盘目录、投影缓存记录、工作区登记，并广播 `api-session/removed` 让侧栏即时刷新
  - `POST /api/session-cleaner/archive` — 走官方归档流程（隐藏保留）
- **浏览器半边**（`lib/client.js`）注册侧栏图标与主面板（React UI，使用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量自适应明暗主题）

### 安全说明

- 删除不可恢复，删除前请确认不再需要该对话。
- 「使用中」的对话（本次应用运行中打开过 / 正在运行）默认被跳过；强制删除后，该对话窗口在本应用运行期间仍可继续使用，但**重启应用后新产生的消息不会保留**。
- 附件（图片 / 文件字节）按内容寻址共享存储，删除对话不会删除附件文件，避免误伤其他对话。
- 只删除对话记录本身，不会改动任何工作区目录里的文件。

## 开发

- host 半边：`lib/index.js`（Node / Cordis Service）
- 浏览器半边：`lib/client.js`（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 预编译格式，无需构建步骤，`dsh.client` 直接加载）
- 配置注入：`cordis.patch.yml`（把本包注册为插件行）

已在隔离 DSH_HOME 中通过端到端测试（列表 / 删除 / 归档 / 强制删除 / 客户端加载 / 面板渲染），并在真实 desktop 配置组成中验证插件激活与数据列表。

## 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)

# dsh-session-tool

会话太多删不掉？归档只是隐藏、记录还躺在磁盘上？想给一个会话换个名字还要翻菜单？

**给 DSH 补上会话管理：侧栏「⋯」菜单一键删除（永久删除、可配置），对话区头部一键重命名。**

> ⚠️ **删除是永久删除，不可恢复**（本插件没有回收站）。删除**正在运行**的会话时，会**先停止该会话，然后再删除**。

![界面示意](docs/preview.png)

## 安装

```sh
# npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-tool

# 本地目录
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-session-tool

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-session-tool
```

装完**重启 DSH**。`<profile>` 替换成你的 profile 名（如 `web`、`desktop`）。

## 功能

- **⋯ 菜单「删除会话」**：文案、顺序、显隐、红色危险样式、禁用态都可配置
- **头部「重命名会话」✏️**：走官方 `sessions` 服务，改完侧栏与头部标题即时更新
- **一次确认**：勾选「我已了解后果」才能点删除（未勾选时按钮禁用）
- **永久删除 + 先停止**：运行中的会话先 `cancel` 并等静默（最多 15 秒），再 flush/detach，最后删除目录并清理记账
- **官方悬停按钮可隐藏**：归档 / 置顶两个图标按钮（只支持 `hidden`）
- **审计日志**：配置问题与每一次删除都写 `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`

## 配置

写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`），**键名区分大小写**，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。
**只写你要改的部分**，没写的键全部用默认值。

### 完整 schema

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # ⋯ 菜单里的项
      official:                    # 官方 4 项（不写 = 一个都不碰）
        pin:     { }               # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename:  { }               # 只支持 hidden（重命名对话框是官方内部实现）
        fork:    { }               # 可写：label / order / hidden
        archive: { }               # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin:
        delete:
          label: "删除会话"         # 文案（留空 = 跟随系统语言）
          order: 500               # 顺序，越小越靠前
          hidden: false            # true = 隐藏这一项
          danger: true             # 红色危险样式
          disabled: false          # 禁用态：变灰、点不动
          shortcut: null           # 【已登记，本阶段未实现】
          separatorBefore: false   # 【已登记，本阶段未实现】
    ButtonItems:                   # 会话行悬停时的图标按钮
      official:
        archive: { hidden: false } # 只支持 hidden
        pin:     { hidden: false } # 只支持 hidden（已归档的行上本来也不显示）
      plugin: { }                  # 占位：本插件不提供悬停按钮
```

### order 参考值

`order` 是普通数字，**升序排列**：越小越靠前；**不写等于 0**（会排在最前面）；数字相同则按注册顺序（官方先注册，排在我们前面）。

| order | 菜单项 | 来源 | 能否修改 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 置顶会话 `pin` | 官方 | label / activeLabel / order / hidden |
| 200 | 重命名 `rename` | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |
| 300 | 分叉会话 `fork` | 官方 | label / order / hidden |
| 400 | 归档会话 `archive` | 官方 | label / activeLabel / order / hidden |
| 500 | 删除会话 `delete` | 本插件（默认） | 全部字段 |

| order | 悬停按钮 | 来源 | 能否修改 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 归档按钮 | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |
| 200 | 置顶按钮 | 官方 | ⚠️ 只能 hidden |

### 我的配置（实际在用的）

```yaml
# order 参考：官方 pin 100 / rename 200 / fork 300 / archive 400；本插件 delete 默认 500
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # ⋯ 菜单里的项
      official:                    # 官方 4 项：不写就不碰
        pin: {}                    # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename: {}                 # 只支持 hidden
        fork: {}                   # 可写：label / order / hidden
        archive: {}                # 可写：label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin:
        delete:                    # 本插件唯一的菜单项
          label: "删除会话"
          order: 500
          hidden: false
          danger: true             # 红色危险样式
          disabled: false          # 禁用态（变灰、点不动）
    ButtonItems:                   # 会话行【悬停时】的图标按钮
      official:
        archive:
          hidden: true             # 隐藏官方悬停「归档」按钮
        pin:
          hidden: true             # 隐藏官方悬停「置顶」按钮
      plugin: {}                   # 占位：本插件不提供悬停按钮
```

## 界面

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧栏会话行「⋯」菜单 | 「删除会话」（文案/顺序/显隐/危险样式/禁用态可配） |
| 对话区头部工具栏 | ✏️「重命名会话」（该排最左侧） |
| 会话行悬停区 | 官方归档/置顶按钮（可隐藏）；本插件不提供悬停按钮 |

**删除弹窗四态**

| 状态 | 触发 | 表现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 正常 | 会话在列表且未运行 | 副标题「删除后，该对话将不可恢复」+ 勾选框 + 删除按钮（未勾选时禁用） |
| 运行中 | 会话正在运行 | 多一行 ⚠「会话正在运行 —— 删除会立即中断它正在进行的任务」，勾选框与按钮变成「停止并删除」 |
| 会话不存在 | 列表里找不到该会话 | 提示刷新后重试，隐藏勾选框、禁用删除按钮 |
| 删除成功 | 删除完成 | 「已删除」+「该对话已永久删除，无法恢复。」+ 完成按钮 |

**重命名**：输入框预填当前名称、自动聚焦；名称为空时「确定」禁用；回车提交、Esc 取消；失败在弹窗内显示原因。

## 实现说明

**删除链路**（六步）

1. 界面校验：回环地址 + 同源请求（其他来源 403，方法不对 405）
2. 运行中的会话：`cancel` 取消回合并等待静默（最多 15 秒）
3. `flush` 写盘 + 从内存会话表 `detach`，避免收尾阶段把日志目录重建回来
4. **删除磁盘目录**（收尾再扫一遍）—— 这一步是永久删除，文件不进入任何回收目录
5. 清理记账：投影缓存行、投影缓存文件、工作区 `sessionIds`、归档集合
6. 写审计日志

**加载稳健性**

- 客户端 `apply` **必须同步完成**：任何 `await`（尤其是网络请求）都可能让入口永远停在 `loading`
- 界面配置在后台读取（3 秒超时、失败重试 5 次 × 2 秒），到达后自动重建注册；读不到就用默认值
- 宿主的三条 HTTP 路由按**进程级单例**注册（同进程重复加载时复用，不撞 `duplicate exact route`）

**官方悬停按钮的隐藏是怎么实现的（维护提示）**

插槽契约写着「复用官方 id 就会替换那一行」，但实测**跨插件不可靠**：框架给每个插件各自分配注册优先级，
官方注册的条目数量多、计数更靠前，于是官方那行仍然胜出。所以本插件改用 **DOM/CSS 级隐藏**：

```html
<style id="dsh-session-tool-hide-shipped">
  button[aria-label="归档会话"],button[aria-label="取消归档"],
  button[aria-label="Archive session"],button[aria-label="Unarchive session"],
  button[aria-label="置顶会话"],button[aria-label="取消置顶"],
  button[aria-label="Pin session"],button[aria-label="Unpin session"] { display: none !important; }
</style>
```

> ⚠️ **维护提示**：这段选择器依赖官方按钮的 `aria-label` 文案（中英各 2 种状态，共 8 条）。
> 如果 DSH 更新后官方改了这些文案（或新增状态），隐藏会失效 —— 此时只需在 `lib/client.js` 的
> `ARCHIVE_LABELS` / `PIN_LABELS` 两个数组里补上新文案即可。日志里每次加载都会记录 `cssRules=<条数>`，可用来核对。

## 日志

`~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`（超过 1 MB 轮转为 `.log.1`）

```
[2026-10-16T09:08:44.519Z] delete ok     id=session-9cc49402-…  title="创建三个空子智能（9cc49402）"  running=false  stopped=false  dirs=1  elapsed=0.0s
[...] plugin info   HTTP 路由已注册：/list /config /diag /delete
[...] config warn   未知的配置键 "menuItems" → 你是否想写 "MenuItems"？（键名区分大小写）
[...] client info   config #1: ok | changed=true | hiddenButtons=archive,pin | cssRules=8
```

配置写错**不会**打断 DSH 启动，只会记一行日志并忽略该项。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-tool
```

## 更新日志

完整版本记录见 [`changelog/CHANGELOG.md`](changelog/CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-session-tool

Too many sessions and no way to remove them? Archiving only hides a session while its files stay on disk? Renaming a session means digging through menus?

**Session management for DSH: delete from the sidebar "..." menu (permanent, configurable) and rename from the conversation header.**

> ⚠️ **Deletion is permanent and unrecoverable** (there is no trash). Deleting a **running** session first stops it, then removes it.

![UI overview](docs/preview.png)

## Installation

```sh
# npm
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-tool

# local checkout
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:C:/path/to/dsh-session-tool

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-session-tool
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Replace `<profile>` with your profile name (e.g. `web`, `desktop`).

## Features

- **"..." menu item "Delete session"**: label, order, visibility, danger styling and disabled state are all configurable
- **Header "Rename session"** (pencil): uses the official `sessions` service, so the sidebar and header titles update live
- **Single confirmation**: the delete button stays disabled until "I understand the consequences" is ticked
- **Permanent delete, stop-first**: a running session is cancelled and awaited (up to 15 s), flushed and detached, then its directories are removed and the accounting is cleaned
- **Official hover buttons can be hidden**: the archive and pin icons (only `hidden` is supported)
- **Audit log**: configuration problems and every deletion are written to `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-session-tool.log`

## Configuration

Put it in the profile patch file `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`. **Keys are case-sensitive** and changes apply after **restarting DSH**.
**Only write what you want to change** - everything omitted keeps its default.

### Full schema

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-tool
  name: dsh-session-tool
  config:
    MenuItems:                     # items in the "..." menu
      official:                    # the 4 shipped items (omitting one leaves it untouched)
        pin:     { }               # writable: label / activeLabel / order / hidden
        rename:  { }               # hidden only (its dialog is official internals)
        fork:    { }               # writable: label / order / hidden
        archive: { }               # writable: label / activeLabel / order / hidden
      plugin

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-refresh

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-refresh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-refresh-plugin)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH desktop 刷新插件 —— 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 增加页面刷新功能。

DSH desktop refresh plugin — adds a page-refresh (reload) feature to the DeepSeek Harness Desktop web UI.

## 背景 / Background

生产版 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的窗口菜单里没有 "Reload Page" 项（该菜单项仅在 development 构建启用），而应用自带的快捷键系统又拒绝"无修饰键"的绑定，因此 **F5 在默认情况下完全不可用**（Ctrl+R 同样没有绑定）。

In production builds of DeepSeek Harness Desktop, the window menu ships no "Reload Page" item (it is development-gated), and the built-in shortcut system rejects bindings without modifiers — so **F5 does nothing by default** (Ctrl+R is unbound too).

本插件在页面（client 端）注册捕获阶段按键监听，补上刷新快捷键。

This plugin registers a capture-phase key listener on the client side to restore refresh shortcuts.

## 快捷键 / Shortcuts

| 按键 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `F5` | 软刷新（reload） |
| `F5` + 任意修饰键（Ctrl / Shift / Alt） | 硬刷新（加 `_dsh_refresh` 时间戳参数绕过缓存） |
| `Ctrl+R` | 软刷新 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+R` | 硬刷新（cache-busted） |

## 安装 / Install

npm 包名：**`dsh-refresh-plugin`**（GitHub 仓库同名；npm 上的 `dsh-refresh` 已被其他用户占用）。

**方式一：从 npm registry 安装（推荐）**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-refresh-plugin
```

**方式二：本地路径安装（开发调试时）**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add F:\code\dsh-desktop-refresh\dsh-refresh
```

安装后**完全退出并重新打开应用**，按 `F5` 即可刷新（应用运行时会监听 profile 的 bundles 列表变化并自动重组 loader，但当前已加载的页面不会包含新监听器）。

## 卸载 / Uninstall

在应用内"插件"页面移除 `dsh-refresh`。

## 工作原理 / How it works

- 插件是一个标准 DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` 声明 loader 挂载行，`dsh.client` 声明 client 端），通过官方 `dsh plugin` CLI 安装进 profile。
- Host 端（`lib/index.js`）是一个空 `apply` —— 功能全部在 client 端（`lib/client.js`）。
- client 端使用捕获阶段 `keydown` 监听：原生快捷键系统会先消费它认领的键，未认领的键才到达 DOM，因此不会与现有快捷键冲突（裸 `F5` 也无法通过快捷键系统注册）。

[MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-github-hub — a GitHub plugin hub for DeepSeek Harness

A native DSH panel (host half + browser half) that signs in to your GitHub account, keeps a
sign-in history, searches GitHub / npm for `deepseek-harness` (`dsh-plugin`) plugins, and installs
them into the current profile with one click — through exactly the same path as
**Settings → Plugins** and `dsh plugin add`.

Chinese documentation: [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

---

## What it adds

* **Discover** — search GitHub repositories (`topic:dsh-plugin`, `topic:deepseek-harness`,
  `dsh-plugin in:name,description,readme`, …) or npm packages (`keywords:dsh-plugin`).
  *Inspect* reads the repository's `package.json` and tells you whether it really is an
  installable DSH plugin (does it declare `dsh.bundle.patch`? does it ship a `dsh.client` half?).
  *Install* runs the profile's own pnpm path with a live log, cancel support, and an
  "allow the blocked build scripts and retry" button when pnpm withholds lifecycle scripts.
* **Installed** — the profile's bundles and plugin rows, with enable / disable / remove,
  load errors and read-only reasons.
* **Account** — sign in with a **Personal Access Token** or **OAuth Device Flow**
  (bring your own OAuth App `client_id`; no client secret needed). Sign-in / sign-out history
  is persisted and can be cleared.
* **Diagnostics** — a connectivity report for the GitHub API, npm, DNS, the hosts file, `git`
  and `pnpm`, plus which rung of the TLS trust ladder the current requests use.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-github-hub
# local development
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-github-hub
```

Then **restart the desktop app** — reloading the page is not enough, because DSH collects its boot
injection table once per host start, and a new plugin's client bundle only enters that manifest on
the next start (the web profile needs its `dsh web` process restarted for the same reason).
A **git-branch icon** then appears in the left sidebar and opens the panel in the central area.

## Read-only endpoints

Beyond the panel, the host half exposes a few read-only endpoints for troubleshooting (all require
the browser session cookie):

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-github/state` | account, settings, sign-in history, trust ladder, client-bundle graph state |
| `GET /dsh-github/health` | GitHub API, npm, DNS, hosts, git, pnpm checks plus plain-language notes |
| `GET /dsh-github/client` | the graph `rev` and real URL of the client bundle, next to the `rev` computed from the file on disk (a mismatch means edits are not loaded yet) |
| `GET /dsh-github/search?source=github\|npm&q=…` | search |
| `POST /dsh-github/repo/package` | read a repository's `package.json` and judge it |
| `POST /dsh-github/inspect` | pre-flight one spec through the real plugin manager (performs the GitHub connection check, installs nothing) |

## Verified on this machine

* the GitHub API is reachable through the local accelerator at `tls=default` (144 system roots were
  merged into the process default chain at startup), so no insecure rung was needed;
* `pnpm add github:<owner>/<repo>` and `pnpm add git+https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git` both
  fetch and link a real package (37s and 19s, peer dependencies included);
* the official pipeline `pluginManager.installBundle` completed end to end for a `link:` spec
  (pnpm log events → progress polling → bundle activation);
* `POST /inspect` on `github:<owner>/<repo>` returns `{status:'accepted', kind:'git', host:'github.com'}`;
* the fences hold: authenticated 200, no cookie 401, `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 403.

## Signing in

* **Token (recommended)** — create one at <https://github.com/settings/tokens> with `read:user`
  (add `repo` for private repositories) and paste it into the panel.
  It is stored in the DSH credential service as the record `dsh-github-hub/github`
  (kind `grant`) and is **never** sent to the page; the UI only shows login, avatar, scopes and
  the last four characters.
* **Device flow** — create an OAuth App (no client secret required), paste its `client_id`,
  start the flow, enter the one-time code at <https://github.com/login/device>.

## Data

| Item | Location |
|---|---|
| GitHub token | DSH credential service (record `dsh-github-hub/github`) |
| Settings + sign-in history | `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-github-hub.json` (no token, max 200 entries) |
| Install logs | `$DSH_PROFILE_DIR/.plugin-manager/logs/operation-*/pnpm.log` |

All endpoints live under `ctx.webServer` at `/dsh-github/*` behind three fences: loopback (or
explicitly trusted) Host, no cross-site requests, and write requests accepted only from the
local machine.

## GitHub behind a local interceptor

Accelerators such as Watt Toolkit / Steam++ rewrite `github.com`, `api.github.com` and
`raw.githubusercontent.com` to `127.0.0.1` and re-serve them through a local reverse proxy with
its own CA, which Node does not trust by default (`unable to verify the first certificate`).
This plugin walks a trust ladder instead of failing:

1. default trust chain;
2. default roots **plus** the operating system root store (equivalent to `node --use-system-ca`);
3. trust the local interceptor — only when the peer genuinely resolves to loopback **and** the
   setting is enabled, and the UI always reports `tls: local-interceptor` when it happens.

Installing from GitHub uses pnpm's `github:owner/repo` (git) transport, so **`git` must be on
PATH**; the plugin manager performs a bounded connection check before pnpm starts.

## Known limits

* A freshly installed plugin usually still needs an app restart (or page reload) before its
  sidebar icon appears — DSH collects the index injection table once at startup.
* Installing a third-party plugin executes third-party host code inside your DSH process.
  The panel shows repository metadata and the `package.json` verdict, but does not audit code.
* Removing a bundle does not delete data files the third-party plugin wrote under `$DSH_HOME`.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sylphiette-agent · 希露菲 把《无职转生》的**希露菲耶特（Sylphiette）**做成 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的一个角色扮演预设： 装上之后，新建会话时选「希露菲」就能直接和她对话。 - **全中文人设**：身份、外貌、性格、成长经历、说话方式（含"括号内第三人称 / 引号内第一人称"的对话标记规则） - **453 条六面世界设定**：魔法、剑术流派、种族、地理、国家、组织、魔道具、学园规则…… 按对话**自动调取**（命中关键词才注入），另有 `lore_lookup` 工具可主动检索 - **剧情**：她只钟情于你（原卡的三角恋线已删除） - **尺度**：成人向（NSFW） > ⚠️ **本预设包含成人向内容，仅供成年人在本地个人使用。** 请勿传播、转售或用于商业用途。 > 这是《无职转生》的非官方同人二创，原作版权属于理不尽な孫の手及相关出版方。 --- ## 安装 本包是一个标准的 DSH **profile bundle**（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）， 所以官方途径和手动兜底都行。 ### 方式一：官方命令（推荐） ```bash # 普通（dsh web / 非桌面版）——把 换成你的 profile 名，通常是 web 或 default dsh plugin --profile add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` **Desktop（桌面版应用）用户注意**：桌面版把自己的 `desktop` profile 锁给了 Electron 进程， 直接用全局 `dsh` 会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。 请改用桌面版自带的 CLI，或干脆用 GUI： ```powershell # Windows： 换成你装 DeepSeek Harness 的地方 & "\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent ``` 或者：打开 DSH 界面 → 侧栏**插件** → 添加插件 → 把包名/URL 粘进去。 > `github:` 这种写法需要机器上有 **git**（DSH 会先 `git ls-remote` 探一下）。 > 没装 git 的话，用下面的 tarball 写法或方式二。 **不想装 git？用 Release 里的 tgz**（`dsh plugin` 支持 tarball URL，不需要 git）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile add https://github.com/JunYingLingLan/dsh-sylphiette-agent/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-sylphiette-agent-1.0.1.tgz ``` ### 方式二：兜底脚本（不碰 pnpm、不需要 git、不需要 DSH CLI） 适合桌面版用户，或者在官方途径上卡住的时候： ```bash # 先把仓库下载/克隆到本地，进入包根目录，然后： node bin/install.mjs # 先预览，什么都不改 node bin/install.mjs --apply # 真正安装 ``` 它会： 1. 把整包拷到 `/dsh-sylphiette-agent/`（默认 `~/.dsh`，Windows 是 `C:\Users\你\.dsh`） 2. 把包内的 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明内联进 `/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`， 并把插件路径转成绝对 `file://` URL 3. 备份原来的 patch，然后逐项验证 可选参数：`--home `、`--profile <名字>`、`--patch <文件>`、`--uninstall --apply`。 自动探测失败时先加 `--home` 指明位置。 ### 装完之后 —— 必须重启一次 ⚠️ **装完请重启 DeepSeek Harness**（桌面版关掉再打开；`dsh web` 用户重启那个进程）。 实测结论：**新装的 bundle 不会被 HMR 自动加载**。装完立刻看是看不到「希露菲」的——组合产物 （`profiles//cordis.yml`）里也不会有它，因为那份配置是在装包**之前**就组合好的。 重启后配置重新组合，希露菲才会出现在预设列表里。 重启后：新建会话 → Agent 预设 选「希露菲」。 ### v1.0.1 修了什么 v1.0.0 里插件行写的是相对路径 `./lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs`，那是错的： DSH 的 `anchorInsertedPluginNames` 只转换 patch `insert` **本层**的 name（以及 `group.config` 那种形式）， **不会递归进 preset 行 `config.plugins` 里的嵌套插件行**。于是这个相对名被当作相对 **profile 目录**解析 （`profiles/

/lib/...` 并不存在）→ 模块 import 失败 → 插件 fiber 永远起不来。 现象很隐蔽：**persona 是纯文本 config 所以照样生效（人设对），但世界书和 `lore_lookup` 全哑**。 v1.0.1 改用**包名子路径** `dsh-sylphiette-agent/lore` —— 由 DSH 从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析（`createRequire(baseUrl).resolve(...)`，与 `dsh-astrbot-ingress` 同一机制）。 兜底安装器 `bin/install.mjs` 则把它落成安装位置的绝对 `file://` URL。 ## 她是谁 20 岁，四分之一精灵，白发红眼尖耳。对外是阿斯拉王国第三公主爱丽儿的男装护卫「沉默的菲兹」， 在拉诺亚魔法大学读书，擅长无咏唱施法。**私下只对你一个人软**—— 你就是她童年唯一的光：教她无咏唱施法的人、转移事件里和她一起活下来的人、两年里和她过着双重生活的人。 ## 世界书是怎么工作的（为什么不用把 453 条全塞进去） 453 条设定约 2.7 万 token。全部塞进系统提示的话，每一轮对话都要付这个成本，还会把真正重要的对话挤到角落。 所以本包用插件 `lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs` 做两条通道： - **自动调取**：你这轮（及上一轮）说的话命中某个关键词时，对应条目才会被加进系统提示； 没命中就不加（返回空串的段会被 DSH 丢掉，不留残留）。 - **主动查询**：模型可以调用 `lore_lookup` 工具查任意条目（按关键词或编号）。 关键词做了三层匹配，因为译出来的键常常是「爱丽儿的护卫」这种描述性长词，而你嘴里说的是「爱丽儿」： | 层 | 例子 | 权重 | |---|---|---| | 完整键 | 爱丽儿的护卫 | 2 | | 按「的 / · / 、」切分的片段 | 爱丽儿、菲兹 | 1 | | 剥掉类别后缀（王国 / 大学 / 流 / 魔法…） | 阿斯拉王国 → 阿斯拉 | 1 | 想调节强度：改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `sylphiette-lore` 的 `maxEntries`（单轮最多注入几条）、 `maxChars`（字符上限）、`scanTurns`（回看几轮）、`excludeUids`（不想自动注入的条目编号）。 ## 改成你想要的样子 人设正文在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `persona.config.prefix`（一大段中文 YAML 块标量）。 改完**必须重新安装**（内容是被内联进 profile 的，DSH 不会自动监视）： ```bash node bin/install.mjs --apply # 方式二装的 # 或 dsh plugin --profile add # 官方方式装的（升级＝卸载重装） ``` ⚠️ 两个坑：人设里**不能出现 `{{...}}`**（DSH 的提示词插值遇到未知变量会直接报错），也不能有 Tab。 ## 卸载 ```bash node bin/install.mjs --uninstall --apply ``` 或走官方：`dsh plugin --profile remove dsh-sylphiette-agent`。 ## 包结构 ``` package.json name / bin / dsh.bundle.patch cordis.patch.yml bundle 声明：preset 行 + persona + sylphiette-lore lib/sylphiette-lore.mjs 世界书插件（关键词自动注入 + lore_lookup 工具） data/lorebook.zh.json 453 条中文设定 bin/install.mjs 兜底安装器 ``` ## 来源与许可 - 角色卡原作：SillyTavern 角色卡 `Sylphiette`（作者 **tupapichulo69**） - 世界观资料：`main_The Six Sided World Lorebook (Mushoku Tensei)_world_info`（453 条） - 本包的改动：全部译成简体中文、删除鲁迪乌斯相关感情线、尺度调整、世界书改为按需注入 - 《无职转生》版权属于原作者**理不尽な孫の手**及相关出版方；本包是非官方同人二创，请仅作个人娱乐 代码部分以 MIT 许可发布（见 `LICENSE`），其中附加的同人/成人向使用说明请一并遵守。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state. Structurally incapable of per-block screening, which was measured wrong.
plugins.readme_text:
# context-verdict

One verdict for a whole session, before it is compacted.

## Quick start

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-verdict@0.1.2
```

context_verdict_build / context_verdict_judge is now available; Build a session snapshot, then ask for one verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state.


## The question, and the question this tool refuses

> **Is there unlanded state that a compaction would lose?**

That is a question about the *session*, not about any part of it. It has a
decidable answer: work either exists somewhere durable or it does not.

**This tool cannot tell you which parts of a context are important.** That was
tried. A per-block screener — "which of these thirty blocks can be dropped?" — was
built and measured, and it failed in both directions at once:

| what it judged | verdict | confidence |
|---|---|---|
| the block containing the actual fix | droppable | **0.323** |
| a nursery rhyme | worth keeping | **0.691** |

The most expensive possible error and pure noise, on the same data, in the same
run. So the capability is absent by construction rather than by policy — see
"Structural, not promised" below.

## The three verdicts

| verdict | meaning |
|---|---|
| `safe_to_compact` | nothing recorded is unlanded |
| `wait` | the record does not settle it, or the service could not be asked |
| `preserve_first` | recorded work exists nowhere durable and must be written down first |

Exactly three, in that order, and there is no argument that adds a fourth. If you
are asked to drop context, this is the wrong tool — say so, and use the three-value
answer instead.

## What counts as unlanded

The closed field set is read, rendered into the state, and **counted**. The count is
what the risk band compares against, so a field that is rendered but not counted
would be work the verdict cannot see. All five unlanded fields count: unlanded
todos, changed-and-uncommitted files, unanswered questions, unrecorded decisions,
and next steps. `session` and `risk_hints` are not items and are not counted.

| field | counted as unlanded | why |
|---|---|---|
| `uncommitted` | yes | changed and not committed |
| `todos` | yes | not marked done in the session's own record |
| `questions` | yes | asked and not answered |
| `decisions` | yes | made and not recorded durably |
| `next_steps` | yes | planned and not landed |
| `risk_hints` | no | derived from the counts above, not an item |
| `session` | no | identity, not work |

A session whose only unlanded work is recorded decisions is therefore **not**
`safe_to_compact`: the count is above zero, so the local rules either decline into
`wait` or, past `waitMin`, answer `preserve_first`.

## Structural, not promised

"We will not write that loop" is a promise, and the measurement above is what
happens when a promise is all you have. Four gates, each with an executable
assertion, and the artefact check injects the thing each one forbids:

**G1 — the model's input cannot name a block.** The state comes from exactly one
renderer over a closed field set (`session`, `todos`, `uncommitted`, `questions`,
`decisions`, `next_steps`, `risk_hints`) and no field can express a block. `judge`
accepts only a state bound to its summary **by digest**, so a hand-assembled state
is refused rather than accepted on its word.

**G2 — three values plus one scale.** One `choice` question with exactly three
fixed options, plus one `score`. A request with four options is refused; a
four-option request is injected in the artefact check.

**G3 — no slot for a selection.** `FORBIDDEN_KEYS` is a constant of 35 names, and a
payload carrying one **throws rather than being stripped**. Stripping would return a
plausible verdict while hiding that something upstream produces the forbidden
shape. The refusal names the path (`$.outer.inner[0].perBlock`) and cites the
measurement.

**G4 — no per-block API surface.** Three tools. No `screen`, no `filter`, no `pick`.

## What `wait` means

`wait` is the answer in three situations, and none is a bug:

1. the recorded unlanded count is ambiguous — inside the band between `safeMax` and
   `waitMin` — so the local rules decline;
2. no service is configured, so the question cannot be asked;
3. the service was asked and was not there.

The reason codes say which. In all three the answer is **not** permission: this
tool never treats "I could not decide" as "go ahead". The local path decides the
two ends — nothing unlanded, or more than the threshold — and does not spend a
request on either.

## Exit codes

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | no `lost` case was let through |
| `1` | a `lost` case **was** judged `safe_to_compact` |
| `2` | the state exceeded its character budget — a configuration problem, not a verdict |
| `3` | usage, configuration or input error |

A run where the service was absent is exit **0** with every case counted as SKIP.
That is deliberate and it is the one place this project treats an unrun check as
success: exit 0 means "nothing was let through", and a check that did not run let
nothing through. SKIP is counted and listed separately so the distinction survives
into the report, and `allSkipped` is reported so a caller is not left to infer it.

## `verify` checks both directions

`verify` runs a labelled corpus and reports two rates, because a verdict system can
fail in two ways and only one is dangerous:

* **`lost` let through as `safe_to_compact`** — the dangerous one. Work is compacted
  and gone. Exit **1**.
* **`keep` refused** — the safe direction, and still a defect. A tool that always
  answers `preserve_first` never loses anything and is useless, so
  over-conservatism is counted rather than congratulated.

**A single-labelled corpus is refused, not scored.** "No lost case was let through"
over a corpus with no lost cases is true and meaningless, which is worse than a red
check — it is the failure mode this project's whole family keeps hitting.

## Limits, stated rather than implied

`safe_to_compact` means **nothing recorded is unlanded**. A session holding work in
a form the transcript does not capture would look identical, and this tool cannot
tell the difference. That is a limit of what is observable, not a guarantee about
the session.

The digest is an **integrity check, not a security control**. Anyone can recompute
one. What it prevents is the accidental case — a caller assembling their own state,
or an old state drifting from its summary — and it makes a bypass deliberate rather
than incidental. Do not describe it as a defence against a caller who wants around
it.

## Requirements

Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. No runtime dependencies. `@deepseek-ai/cordis` is an
optional peer.

## Testing

```sh
npm test                  # 43 assertions, no host required
npm run verify:artifacts   # what npm publish would actually ship
```

The verifier is about **absence**, which is the hardest thing to check: a gate that
has been removed looks exactly like a gate that found nothing wrong. So it injects
each forbidden thing — all 35 forbidden keys, a hand-assembled state, a four-option
request, a single-labelled corpus — and requires the code to refuse it.

## License

Apache-2.0.

plugins.description: Render AI answers as interactive UI cards in DSH: comparisons, charts, diagrams, tables, calculators and unit conversions. The model writes a JSON spec — never markup.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# dsh-intelligent-ui

Generative UI for DSH conversations. The model calls one tool, `ui_render`,
writes a JSON UI Schema — and the page renders a live, state-bound interactive
interface: forms, KPIs, charts and tables linked by shared state, micro-apps,
maps, streaming growth. The same tool also renders ten fixed card kinds for
answers that are a single static structure, and a Schema Playground for humans.

The model writes **data, never HTML/JSX/JavaScript**. Specs are plain JSON, so
they survive the session log, a fork and a resume unchanged. Bindings run in a
hand-written safe expression language (no `eval`, fixed function table), state
changes flow through an Action Router that reports only effects that really
happened, and semantic tones resolve to theme tokens so every card works in
light and dark.

## Two vocabularies

**Fixed cards** — one structure per answer, render instantly, no state:

| `kind` | When to use | Main fields |
|--------|-------------|-------------|
| `compare` | three or more things compared on shared criteria | `columns`, `rows[{label, cells[]}]` |
| `chart` | a series of magnitudes (`bar`), a trend (`line`), parts of one whole (`pie` / `donut`) | `series[{label, value, tone?, hint?}]`, `variant`, `unit` |
| `stats` | two to six headline figures | `stats[{label, value, tone?, hint?}]` |
| `progress` | one ratio to feel at a glance — pass rate, quota used | `value`, `max`, `label`, `unit`, `tone` |
| `steps` | three or more ordered steps | `steps["text" \| {text, detail?}]` |
| `table` | rows and columns of records | `columns`, `rows[][]` |
| `diagram` | boxes joined by arrows, or any Mermaid family | `nodes[{id, label, detail?, tone?}]` + `edges[{from, to, label?}]` + `layout`, or raw `mermaid` |
| `calculator` | arithmetic the user will redo with their own numbers | `mode: split \| tip`, `fields[{label, value, min?, max?}]` |
| `unit` | a quantity converted between units | `units`, `factors?`, `from`, `to`, `value` |
| `note` | one thing the reader must not miss | `text`, `tone` |

**Generative UI** — `kind: "app"`, the interactive vocabulary:

| `kind` | When to use | Main fields |
|--------|-------------|-------------|
| `app` | an interactive tool, simulator or dashboard the user adjusts and watches update live | `state`, `compute`, `tree` (`{id, type, props, bind, on, children}`), `stream` |
| `playground` | an editable JSON UI Schema with live validation and preview | `source` (JSON text; a broken schema is expected and shown) |

An `app` is a component tree drawn from a 71-type registry — 77 names with the
chart aliases (text, layout,
controls, charts, tables, maps, media, feedback, `quiz`/`flashcard`/
`countdown`), wired together by `bind` expressions over `state` + `compute`
and `on` actions (`set`, `toggle`, `copy`, `open`, `submit`, `call`). One input
change updates every dependent KPI, chart and table at once.

## How it works

```text
the model writes a spec (plain JSON)
   ↓
index.js      host half: ui_render tool + one prompt section;
              normalizeSpec (fixed cards) and the node budget
   ↓
engine.cjs    shared half: registry, safe expression language,
              validateApp, computeAll/resolveProps, planAction,
              streaming protocol — same code on both sides
              (build-engine.mjs wraps it into client.engine.js)
   ↓
client.js     client half: renders into the tool.call.toolview slot —
              fixed cards, the app runtime (state, actions, toasts),
              the 71-component REGISTRY, Mock Streaming, the Playground
```

- **Host half** (`index.js`): the tool schema and prompt section live next to
  the validator; structured `diagram` specs are compiled to Mermaid source on
  the Host, so the session log stores exactly the diagram that was drawn.
- **Shared engine** (`engine.cjs`, CommonJS on purpose): the Host `import`s it,
  the Client loads `client.engine.js`. Both halves validate and evaluate with
  identical code — they cannot drift.
- **Client half** (`client.js`): everything visual. Charts and diagrams go
  through ECharts/Mermaid lazy chunks (`client.echarts.js` / `client.mermaid.js`,
  generated, git-ignored); everything else is plain React over theme tokens.

Details: [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) ·
[docs/schema.md](docs/schema.md) · [docs/components.md](docs/components.md).

### Following the font size

DSH's theme presenter writes the user's content font size to `document.body` as
`--dsh-content-font-size` (10–22px) and emits `theme/change` on every change.
Stylesheet rules are `calc(<authored size> + var(--iui-fs-delta))`, so a whole
card scales from one write; ECharts and Mermaid get real px numbers from the
same variable, with a floor so the smallest labels stay readable.

### Table overflow

Columns are unbounded — a wide table scrolls sideways. Rows cap at 15: past
that the body scrolls inside the card with a pinned header. The cap is a row
count, not a pixel height, so it stays 15 rows at every font size.

## Quick start

### Build

The three chunks are **generated** and git-ignored. Build them after
installing, or charts degrade to a plain-text summary and apps cannot load the
engine:

```bash
pnpm install
node build-engine.mjs && node build-echarts.mjs && node build-mermaid.mjs
```

The scripts wrap the sources in DSH's module-loader envelope: `engine.cjs`
verbatim, ECharts through its UMD `exports` branch (no global leak), Mermaid's
`globalThis` assignment captured and removed again.

### Install into a DSH profile

Add this repo to your DSH profile dependencies — a local `link:` or a GitHub
URL both work:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-intelligent-ui": "link:<absolute path>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-intelligent-ui"] } }
}
```

Insert the plugin line in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: intelligent-ui
      name: 'dsh-intelligent-ui'
```

Then install:

```bash
cd "$DSH_PROFILE_DIR"
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
```

## Demos

Seven runnable app specs live under [`demos/`](demos) — full descriptions in
[docs/demos.md](docs/demos.md). Each file is an `app` spec without the `kind`
wrapper; wrap it as `{"spec": {"kind": "app", …}}` or paste it into a
`playground` card's `source`.

| File | Scenario | Highlights |
|------|----------|------------|
| `demos/1-travel.json` | 京都旅行规划助手 / Kyoto trip planner | linked `map` + `places` selection, cost donut, itinerary table |
| `demos/2-analytics.json` | 销售分析仪表盘 / sales analytics dashboard | KPI row, segmented-control area chart, searchable/filterable/exportable `dataTable` |
| `demos/3-invest.json` | 理财复利模拟器 / compound-interest simulator | inputs → KPIs → line chart → progress bar, plus a `call` action that honestly reports "not connected" |
| `demos/4-learn.json` | 勾股定理互动讲解 / Pythagoras theorem lesson | safe-shape SVG triangle, `math` formula subset, tabs, flashcards |
| `demos/5-split.json` | AA 分账计算器 / bill split | compute + donut + per-person table, `copy` via `expr`, `form` + `submit` |
| `demos/6-quiz.json` | 世界地理问答闯关 / geography quiz | `quiz` micro-app, score → state (`on.change` expr), badge flips on pass |
| `demos/7-stream.json` | 流式渲染演示 · 服务负载看板 / streaming service-load dashboard | Mock Streaming (`stream: {mode: "mock"}`) progressive growth |

## Testing

```bash
node test/engine.mjs           # engine contract: expressions, validation, actions, streaming (69 checks)
node test/normalize.mjs        # fixed cards + app/playground normalization: happy paths + guards (78 checks)
node test/echarts-chunk.mjs    # loads the generated ECharts chunk without a browser
node test/render-svg.mjs       # ECharts SSR renders charts into test/out for inspection
node test/render-mermaid.mjs   # headless Mermaid diagram families into test/out-mermaid
node test/shot-mermaid.mjs     # Chrome screenshots (Mermaid labels are foreignObject HTML)
node test/font-and-overflow.mjs# headless: font tracking, wide-table scroll, 15-row cap
node test/font-live.mjs        # headless: a font-size change re-renders a mounted card + chart
node test/shot-font.mjs        # screenshots at 10/14/22px into test/ou

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify —— 用于 DSH 的桌面壁纸 + 毛玻璃美化插件（零布局侵入、可逐字节回滚、自带诊断面板）
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify **语言 / Languages:** 中文（本页） ｜ **English**（点击下方「English version」展开） > 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。项目名 **DSH UI Beautify**：包名 `dsh-ui-beautify`，路由 `/dsh-ui-beautify/*`，全局 `__DSHUI__`，存储键 `__dshui.*`。 > 原包名 `dsh-dsniang-beautify` 的旧存档会自动迁移；旧 hash（`#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag`）与旧 URL 参数（`?dsniang=`）仍兼容。 > 仓库：`Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`（私有） **版本：v0.8.5** · 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。 > ⚠️ **v0.1 出过事故**：它会改目标面板的 `position` / `overflow`，导致界面布局坍塌、 > 基本无法操作。v0.2 从设计上取消了所有这类改动，详见下面「为什么 v0.2 不会再弄坏界面」。 ---
English version（点击展开 / Click to expand） # English version **DSH UI Beautify** — a wallpaper + frosted-glass beautifier for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop client. Package `dsh-ui-beautify` · routes `/dsh-ui-beautify/*` · global API `__DSHUI__` · storage keys `__dshui.*`. Settings stored under the old package name (`dsh-dsniang-beautify`) are migrated automatically; the legacy hashes `#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag` and the legacy URL parameter `?dsniang=` still work. Repository: `Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`. > This is the English manual. The Chinese manual above is the full one (troubleshooting, internals, release tooling). ## What it does - **Three modes**: **Off** (factory default — touches nothing) / **Texture** (multiply blending; the wallpaper is tinted into the UI) / **Backdrop** (the image is truly behind the content, with a scrim slider). - **Real frosted glass** (`backdrop-filter`): composer card, user bubbles, DSH dialogs and menus, the whale-widget panel, and — in Backdrop mode — code blocks and attachment cards in the chat. All share one parameter set. - **Two wallpapers**: drop `deepseek 4k.png` / `deepseek 黑白无水面.png` on your Desktop and those are used; otherwise the bundled WebP fallbacks are used (you always have two options on any machine). Switching is a cross-fade (no blank frame). - **Click the background** → fades to the default background (420 ms), then restores the wallpaper after **2 s**. - Clicking bubbles, the composer, buttons, links or icons is **never intercepted**. - **Built-in diagnostics** (`Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I`): mode, wallpaper source and health, glass state, frame rate — no DevTools required. - **Motion**: the shared foundation is in place (master switch **off** by default); decorative animations are deliberately left for later. ## Three buttons | Button | Effect | Does it touch the page layout? | |---|---|---| | **Off** (default) | Everything restored; nothing is mounted | No | | **Texture** | Multiply wallpaper (default concentration 0.49) + frosted glass (with "clearing" of the composer seat's own scrim) | Adds our own layers, a class toggle, and clears background colors (byte-exact restore) | | **Backdrop** | The image really sits behind everything (`z-index:-1`), with theme-aware scrim; the shell's full-screen opaque background is overridden by a class toggle; frosted glass works here too | Only our own layers + one class-toggle rule | ## Factory defaults | Item | Default | Stored in | |---|---|---| | Startup mode | **Off** | `localStorage['__dshui.mode']` | | Texture concentration | **0.49** | `localStorage['__dshui.opacities']` | | Backdrop concentration | **0.5** | same | | Scrim strength | 0 (slider 0–90%, 1% steps) | `localStorage['__dshui.scrim']` | | Wallpaper | **`deepseek 4k.png`** (shown as `deepseek`) | `localStorage['__dshui.image']` | | Frosted glass | **on** | `localStorage['__dshui.frost.v3']` | | Glass blur / white layer | **2 px / 20%**（径向渐变：内部更透） | same | | Panel white layer (edge / center) | **94% / 80%**（径向渐变） | same | | Bubble transparency / color / blur | **45% / original color / 12 px** | same | | DSH panel blur | **20 px** | same | | Motion | **off** (master switch; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M`) | `localStorage['__dshui.motion.v1']` | | Startup splash | **on** (Rhine-Lab-style loading animation; panel toggle, `?splash=0` or `prefers-reduced-motion` skips it) | `localStorage['__dshui.splash.v1']` | | Pill position | `10, 10` (top-left) | `localStorage['__dshui.pill']` | Defaults apply only when nothing is stored yet; once you move a slider, the stored value wins. ## Install 1. Extract `dsh-ui-beautify-0.8.5.zip` → you get a `dsh-ui-beautify/` directory (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib` / `assets` (both fallback images) / `test` / `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` / `README.md` / `HANDOFF.md` / `LICENSE` — 13 entries); 2. Put it somewhere that won't be deleted (an ASCII-only path is recommended); 3. Install it through the official plugin channel with the extracted directory as `target`: `pluginManager.installBundle('file:D:\\dsh-plugins\\dsh-ui-beautify')` (same as `dsh plugin add file:...`); 4. **Restart the DSH client** (the bundle stack is collected once at startup); 5. Self-check: `node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs` inside the extracted directory — all green. The official channel registers three things (all of them are needed, otherwise the plugin manager treats the bundle as a stray entry): the `node_modules/dsh-ui-beautify` junction, the profile `package.json` `dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies`, and the `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer record. ## Uninstall 1. **Quickest** (no restart): `__DSHUI__.setMode('off')`, or open `...#dshui-off` and reload; 2. **Proper**: Settings → Plugins → `dsh-ui-beautify` → Uninstall (or `pluginManager.removeBundle('dsh-ui-beautify')`); 3. **Manual fallback**: `.rollback/` holds a copy of the pre-install profile config; restore it, remove the junction with `cmd /c rmdir "\node_modules\dsh-ui-beautify"` (links only), then restart DSH. After uninstalling, `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` runs the post-uninstall self-check: it asserts the "four-piece" state (`package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `node_modules/.modules.yaml`, `cordis.yml`) and removes a leftover `node_modules` junction (link only, never the target). Idempotent, supports `-DryRun`, writes a log, exit codes `0/1/2/3/4`. ## External side effects Pure Cordis plugin: it does **not** modify `app.asar`, the registry, scheduled tasks, environment variables or ports; no daemon, no child processes, no external network requests. Only six read-only loopback routes (`/dsh-ui-beautify/*`). Runtime changes are limited to our own DOM nodes, class toggles and CSS variables, all restored byte-exactly on teardown. The startup splash is a **same-origin iframe**; it is removed entirely when it finishes (or is skipped / times out) and never touches the host page CSS. ### User data All settings live in `localStorage` under `__dshui.*` (mode, opacities, scrim, frost, motion, splash, pill, image). Uninstalling **keeps** them by default. To wipe: ```js Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => k.startsWith('__dshui.')).forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)) ``` ## Diagnostics - Panel: `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I` (or open `...#dshui-diag` and reload). - HTTP: `/dsh-ui-beautify/status.json` (wallpaper resolution) and `/dsh-ui-beautify/diag.json` (last report). - Console API: `__DSHUI__.status()` / `.wallpaper()` / `.reapply()` / `.uninstall()` / `.setMode('off'|'multiply'|'backdrop')`. ## Motion The motion foundation (master switch, `prefers-reduced-motion`, pause on blur) and the `requestAnimationFrame` frame-time probe are in place. Motion is **off** by default; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M` toggles it. All future animations must go through `motionAllowed()`. ## Startup splash On page load a **Rhine-Lab-style** startup sequence plays (black identity act → over-exposed wash → technical HUD → six authorization steps → white-flash cut into the session), then fades out and removes itself with zero residue. It is independent of the mode: it plays by default whenever the plugin is installed. - **When it plays**: on by default; skipped automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, with `#dshui-off` (emergency switch), or `?splash=0`; `?splash=1` forces it on for debugging. - **Panel**: an "开屏动画：开/关" toggle (persisted to `__dshui.splash.v1`) plus "↻ 重播" to preview it anytime. - **Console API**: `__DSHUI__.splash.replay()` / `.skip()` / `.setEnabled(true|false)` / `.config()`. - **Isolation**: the splash is a **same-or

plugins.description: 把与你相关的 GitHub PR（我提的 / 待我审 / 我合并的）照进 DSH 侧边栏，复用本机 gh 登录，只读（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-pr-inbox

侧边栏里的 GitHub PR 收件箱：我提的 / 待我审 / 我合并的 三桶照进 DSH 侧栏， 一眼看完"该我动手的那几件"。绑定当前会话工作区的仓库，复用本机已登录的 gh，插件不存任何凭据，只读。

## 为什么需要它 "有没有该我动的 PR" 是个**每隔十几分钟就会重新出现**的问题。现在的做法通常是： 切到浏览器 → 打开 GitHub → 在 Notifications 和几个仓库的 Pull requests 页之间来回看 → 还得自己记住哪些仓库跟自己有关。GH 的通知（网页/邮件/桌面）又是全站级别的噪音： 推送、issue、CI 失败混在一起，真正"等我 review"的那两三条淹没在里面。 这个插件把这件事挪回你**正在用的地方**： - **绑定工作区**：不用选仓库——会话在哪个仓库，面板就是哪个仓库的 PR（`upstream` 优先、其次 `origin`，再退到第一个 remote；fork 布局会绑到主仓而不是你的 fork）。 - **三桶就是三个动作语义**：`我提的`（我该跟进）、`待我审`（等我的动作，计数会变色）、 `我合并的`（我刚做的事落地没有）。想扫的时候一屏扫完。 - **点开就是全文**：正文、评论与评审摘要、改动文件清单都在面板里渲染，读 PR 描述与 讨论不用跳浏览器（看 diff / 行内 review 评论仍要 GitHub，见「已知限制」）。 - **零新凭据**：只用你**已经登录**的 `gh`。不申请 token、不填 PAT、不落盘。 与相邻方案的区别：GitHub 通知是**全站推送**（且不止 PR）；编辑器里的 GitHub 插件通常 绑在"当前文件/当前 diff"。这里是"**当前工作区 + 与我相关**"这一刀，代价是必须先装 `gh` 并登录（见下）。 ## 安装 前置：DSH 已装、本机 `gh` 已登录（`gh auth login`）。面板页签挂在 [better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) 上，所以它也要装。 **dsh 0.2.1 线需要 better-sidebar ≥ 0.28.0**：0.26.x 的 `inject` 仍要求 0.2.1 已移除的 `webRuntime`，页签会永久 pending、界面上没有任何入口。 > **当前状态：已发布到公开仓库 `omdsh-dev/dsh-pr-inbox`**（2026-10-17）。用下面的 > git 源安装；`lib/` 已随仓库提交，不需要构建授权。 **① 装页签宿主**（两种方式都要） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar ``` **② 装本插件** ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add "github:omdsh-dev/dsh-pr-inbox" # 钉版本：用 ...#v0.1.1 ``` 本地开发/自测也可以走 tarball（需要 clone 仓库）： ```bash pnpm install && pnpm pack # 产出 dsh-pr-inbox-0.1.1.tgz dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-pr-inbox-0.1.1.tgz ``` 装完刷新页面（或按 DSH 提示重启 web）即可在**右侧栏**看到 `PR` 页签： 展开右栏 → 从页签列表里选 `PR`。 > `lib/` 构建产物随仓库提交，所以 git 源安装**不需要**任何构建授权 > （不会让你放行 `allowBuilds`，也不会在你的机器上跑构建脚本）。 ## 用起来是什么样 | | | |---|---| | **顶部** | 搜索框（标题 / 编号 / 作者 / 标签，只在已加载的行里过滤）+ `简洁/详细` 切换（选择会记住）+ 刷新 | | **简洁档** | 单行 28px：行首头像 · `#编号` · 标题 · 时间；适合快速扫 | | **详细档** | 两行 50px：第一行与简洁档**同一个位置**，第二行补作者、合并时间、标签、评论数 | | **分区块** | 三个桶各自成区，滚动时当前区的名字与计数贴在上沿；点击区头折叠。空桶只留一行计数（不显示占位文案）；只加载了一页时计数显示 `已加载 / 总数` | | **点开一行** | 面板内打开完整 PR：正文（markdown 渲染，图片走宿主代理）、评论与评审摘要、改动文件清单（状态色标 + 增删行数）；`返回列表` 会回到原来的滚动位置与行焦点，当前项有强调条；详情里按 Esc 也能返回 | | **状态行** | 底部常显绑定的仓库、当前 gh 账号与数据的读取时间（详情页也在） |

> 截图只截插件面板本身（不含宿主聊天区）；详情预览用一篇纯文字正文的 PR，避免把正文里的大图当成插件界面。 ## 能力面 | 面 | 说明 | |---|---| | 侧边栏页签 | `PR` 页签，挂在 better-sidebar 的右栏；跟随 DSH 语言（中/英）与深浅主题 | | 三桶列表 | `我提的`（`author:@me`，开着的）、`待我审`（`review-requested:@me`）、`我合并的`（`is:merged author:@me`，最近 20 条，按合并时间倒序展示） | | 行内操作 | 点行开详情；行内 `↗` 在 GitHub 打开（悬停/键盘聚焦才现形）；点击穿透不会误开外链 | | PR 详情 | 正文、评论与评审摘要（APPROVED / CHANGES_REQUESTED 等）、改动文件清单、分支与增删行、合并/更新时间；正文与单条评论有上限并**如实标注截断** | | 图片 | 正文与评论里的图片都会渲染：GitHub 编辑器插入的 `` HTML 形态会被改写成 markdown 图片，仓库内**相对路径**图片经插件自有路由代理取字节（受限网络下 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 不可达；同时也覆盖私有仓库） | | 头像 | 作者头像；CDN 不可达时回退成首字母圆底——**不会出现破图图标** | | 语言 | 界面文案随 DSH 语言（zh / en）；插件在 Plugins 页的标题与描述也有中英两份 | ## 环境与前置 - **本机 `gh` 必须已登录**：面板的数据全部来自 `gh`（列表走 `gh api search/issues`，详情走 `gh api`）。缺 `gh` 或未登录时，面板给的是可操作提示（装 gh / `gh auth login`）， 而不是空白列表。 - **只支持 `github.com`**：其它 host（自建 GitLab / Gitea 等）会在列表里留一句说明， 详情返回 `unsupported-host`。 - **需要 better-sidebar**：页签宿主。没装时 host 半照常工作，但界面上没有入口 （这是有意设计：不静默失败，也不假装能用）。 ## 已知限制 - **只读**：没有任何写操作——不评论、不 approve、不 merge，也不接管聊天里的 GitHub 链接。 - **`我合并的` 是最近 20 条**，不是时间窗；取数按 GitHub 搜索的 updated 取一页，展示时再按 合并时间倒序。**搜索只在已加载的行里做**，不会去 GitHub 全量搜。 - **详情不含 diff、行内 review 评论与 CI/checks**：review 只到 review 摘要；要读某条行内意见 或看改动本身，仍要打开 GitHub。 - **`gh` 的速率与超时**会如实反映在面板上（未登录 / 限流 / 超时各有各的提示与错误码）。 - **正文图片**只走"仓库内相对路径 + 公开/私有仓库的 `refs/pull//head`"；正文里的 外链图片直接由浏览器加载（受限网络下可能显示不出来）。 - 面板读的是**当前工作区**：会话还没确定工作目录时，面板会提示先产生一次工具调用 或打开文件，让它绑定到某个仓库。 ## 兼容性 | dsh 版本 | 状态 | |---|---| | `0.2.1-rc.1` + better-sidebar `0.28.0` | ✅ 已验证（2026-10-17）：13 个门全绿（静态 9 + git 源 / mounted 浅色+深色 / negative-control / standalone） | | `0.2.0-rc.2` + better-sidebar `0.26.x` | ✅ 已验证（2026-10-16）：真实实例里装、跑、点开详情，含 git 源安装与负控 | | 其它版本 | ⚠️ 未验证。升级 dsh 后若**右栏没有 `PR` 页签**或**面板一直空白**，多半是宿主服务名/槽名或 client 契约变了；0.2.1 线先确认 better-sidebar ≥ `0.28.0` | ## 插件管理 装/卸/启停用官方 CLI：`dsh plugin --profile web add|remove <包>`；已装插件在**侧边栏 Plugins 页**里查看与配置——每个插件自己的配置页挂在那个包页上（Settings 里的「插件」 只是只读清单，改不了配置）。 ## 开发与验证 ```bash pnpm install && pnpm build # 改源码后必须重建并提交 lib/（CI 会校验无漂移） node scripts/gates/run.mjs # 静态门：包契约 / 发布卫生 / 决策记录 / 文档链接 / 产物新鲜度 / 单测 node scripts/gates/run.mjs --list # 还有哪些实例门（真装真跑、负控、git 源安装冒烟） ``` 工程备忘录（机制、实测环境事实、验证证据、决策记录索引）在 [docs/engineering-notes.md](docs/engineering-notes.md)。 ## 许可 MIT

plugins.description: Read-only Agent Team console for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: live roster, shared task board, and collaboration activity.
plugins.readme_text:
# Agent Team Console

Read-only Agent Teams dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (`dsh-agent-team-console`): a
project-scoped, card-grid view of every team, with a top-down pixel-art agent flow graph and rounds /
token / working-time statistics in one first-class main panel.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Repository: <https://github.com/kkomia/dsh-agent-team-console>

> **Unofficial community plugin.** This repository is not part of the DeepSeek official packages, is
> not published or endorsed by DeepSeek, and is not a replacement for the official experimental
> Agent Teams bundle. It is a read-only viewer: it never creates, changes, or completes a team
> member or a task.

## Why this plugin

The official experimental Agent Teams Web UI (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-agent-team`)
adds a compact roster and task-board action to the conversation header. That is convenient for a
quick check while you are inside the Lead conversation, but it is not a page of its own.

Agent Team Console keeps the same read-only contract and adds a sidebar entry plus a full main
panel for people who keep a team running for a long stretch:

- A project filter and a compact status strip covering in-progress tasks, running members, token
  usage, blocked tasks, and pending tasks.
- A responsive grid of workspace cards, with at most one team expanded at a time to show the full
  detail.
- A top-down pixel-art agent flow graph: Lead at the top, teammates in balanced rows below,
  downward hand-off links and curved message arcs between them.
- A one-line task summary with in-progress rows on demand, so the page stays visual instead of a wall
  of text.

It is a plain DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web plugin: no build step for users, no npm dependencies, and no
external services.

## Features

- **Sidebar entry and main panel.** A sidebar item labelled "Team console" (the Chinese UI shows
  "团队看板") opens a dedicated page in the main area.
- **Project filter.** When more than one project (workspace) has live teams, a select appears in the
  header. It defaults to "All projects" and narrows the status strip and the team list to one project;
  the choice is client-side and is not persisted.
- **In-progress-first status strip.** A single compact row of five chips: in-progress tasks, running
  members (running / total), token usage for the current selection, blocked tasks (pending tasks that
  are not ready), and pending tasks. Zero values stay visible but muted.
- **Workspace card grid.** Teams are ordered active first, then by most recent activity, and laid out
  as a responsive grid of block cards. A collapsed card shows a status dot, the workspace/project name
  (falling back to "No project", "未分组" in the Chinese UI), an in-progress badge when non-zero, the
  Lead name, a working-vs-idle donut with team rounds and token totals, and a muted work-vs-idle
  caption. At most one team expands at a time: its card spans the full grid row and shows the full
  header, the flow graph, and the task summary. The default expanded card is the first active team; an
  explicit collapse sticks across polls.
- **Top-down flow graph.** The graph is an SVG data-flow diagram: the Lead/root sits at the top centre,
  and teammates sit in balanced rows below — a single row for up to 5 teammates, otherwise two
  balanced rows with the larger row first (up to 8 members, then a "+N" overflow node in the last row).
  Lead-to-teammate hand-off edges are curved hand-off links that flow downward with a subtle animated
  dash flow, and teammate-to-teammate message edges are curved arcs whose thickness scales with
  message weight and whose opacity scales with recency; same-row arcs bend upward so they clear the
  names. A structural hand-off graph is derived when a payload has no edge data.
- **Pixel-art agents.** Every member is drawn as a deterministic pixel-art character made of SVG
  rectangles from a 10x12 template (no external images): the Lead gets a distinct brand-colored outfit
  and marker, and the theme palette drives outfit accents. The working-ratio ring and token-scaled node
  radius are still there, with a tiny "N rounds · X tok" line under each node. Status motion: running
  bobs and shows a working spark, provisioning spins a dashed ring and blinks softly, idle is muted and
  static, failed keeps a static error ring.
- **Member details on hover or focus.** Hovering or focusing a node opens a compact detail card with
  the model, rounds, steps, token breakdown (uncached input, cache read, cache write, output, total),
  working and idle time, and the member's message in/out summary. Clicking the node opens the member's
  session when workspace navigation is available.
- **Compact task summary.** Each expanded team card shows one line with in-progress, pending, and
  blocked counts and a small expand toggle. Expanding shows only the in-progress tasks as one-line rows
  (subject, owner); pending and completed tasks stay counts only. Blocked follows the readiness rule:
  only a pending task with `ready === false` is blocked, and in-progress tasks are never shown as
  blocked.
- **Activity stays in the API.** The snapshot still carries the bounded activity list for API
  consumers, but the panel no longer renders it.
- **Interactive graph data.** When the host can see it, the snapshot also carries the member graph:
