plugins.description: dsh-custom-brand，大肥鱼品牌图标。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-custom-brand · 大肥鱼品牌图标

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-custom-brand?color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-custom-brand)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-custom-brand)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-custom-brand)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-custom-brand)](LICENSE)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/dyguests/dsh-custom-brand)](https://github.com/dyguests/dsh-custom-brand)
[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/dyguests/dsh-custom-brand)

把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏左上角的品牌位（默认是鲸鱼图标 + `deepseek HARNESS`）换成**你自己的图标和文字**，改一个 JSON 文件、刷新页面即可生效。

![安装前 / 安装后](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dyguests/dsh-custom-brand/main/docs/before-after.png)

> 社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。分类：**UI & Experience**。

## 特性

- **两个位置都覆盖**：`sidebar.brand.mark` 和 `sidebar.brand.name`，折叠成 56px 窄栏时同一个图标位继续生效
- **不用停用官方包**：以更低 `priority` 影子覆盖 single slot，卸载即恢复原样
- **两种图标模式**
  - `glyph`：只取图片形状当剪影，用 `currentColor` 上色 —— 浅色主题近黑、深色主题自动转浅，背景透明（和原版鲸鱼一致）
  - `image`：保留图片本身配色，适合直接放一张头像
- **可配置**：图标、尺寸、圆角、文字、徽标、字号、徽标配色
- **改完即生效**：配置读的是 JSON 文件，图标按 mtime 自动换版本号，刷新页面即可；不需要重新打包

## 安装

从 npm 安装到你的 profile（Web 版通常是 `web`，桌面版是 `desktop`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-custom-brand
```

或者从 GitHub 源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dyguests/dsh-custom-brand
```

安装后在「插件」页确认 `大肥鱼品牌图标` 是打开状态，刷新页面即可看到效果。

## 配置

两个来源，后者覆盖前者：

1. 插件行的 `config:`（在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里）
2. `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-brand.json` —— 首次运行自动生成，日常改这个

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `mark` | `""` | 图标。绝对路径、`~/x.png`、相对 `$DSH_HOME` 的路径、`http(s)://`、`data:` 都可以；留空用包内自带的图 |
| `markMode` | `"glyph"` | `glyph` = 剪影 + `markColor`；`image` = 保留原图配色 |
| `markColor` | `"currentColor"` | `glyph` 模式下的颜色，默认跟随主题文字色 |
| `markSize` | `24` | 图标边长（px），12–48 |
| `markRadius` | `"50%"` | 圆角（仅 `image` 模式），`50%` 为圆形 |
| `name` | `"大肥鱼"` | 主文字，留空则只显示图标 |
| `badge` | `"DSH"` | 小标签，留空则不显示 |
| `showName` | `true` | 是否显示文字 |
| `nameSize` | `"17px"` | 主文字字号 |
| `badgeBg` | `"#1b1f27"` | 标签底色 |
| `badgeFg` | `"#ffffff"` | 标签文字色 |

示例 `~/.dsh/dsh-custom-brand.json`：

```json
{
  "mark": "",
  "markMode": "glyph",
  "markColor": "currentColor",
  "markSize": 24,
  "markRadius": "50%",
  "name": "大肥鱼",
  "badge": "DSH",
  "showName": true,
  "nameSize": "17px",
  "badgeBg": "#1b1f27",
  "badgeFg": "#ffffff"
}
```

也可以直接用接口读写：

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:<port>/api/dsh-custom-brand/config
curl -s -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"我的品牌","badge":"BETA","markMode":"image","mark":"~/Pictures/avatar.png"}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:<port>/api/dsh-custom-brand/config
```

## 启用 / 停用 / 卸载

- **停用**：「插件」页关掉 `大肥鱼品牌图标` 的开关，官方品牌立刻回来
- **卸载**：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-custom-brand`
- **换素材**：把 `mark` 指向你的图片即可；`assets/` 里还放了几版备选剪影（`head-oval.png` 默认、`head-eyes.png`、`head-silhouette.png`、`head-bust.png`、`fat-fish-glyph.png`）

## 兼容性

- DSH `>= 0.2.0`，Web 与桌面（Electron）客户端
- 只依赖客户端插槽 `sidebar.brand.mark` / `sidebar.brand.name`，不改核心文件、不碰 `app.asar`
- 从旧版 `dsh-brand-slot` 升级：旧的 `~/.dsh/dsh-brand-slot.json` 会被自动读取，接口同时保留旧路由别名

## 权限与隐私

- 图标文件由本机 Harness 读取并通过本地 HTTP 路由提供，**不上传到任何服务器**
- 插件只注册 UI 插槽与三个本地路由，不发起外部请求、不读取会话内容

## 素材与许可

- 代码：[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 dyguests
- `assets/head-*.png` 里的大肥鱼剪影取自社区同人立绘（dsh-pet-dafeiyu / codex-deepseek-pet 系列），仅作示例；**二次分发或商用请自行确认原作者授权并署名**
- 角色“大肥鱼”是 DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘形象的社区二创，与 DeepSeek 官方无关

---

## English

**dsh-custom-brand** replaces the Harness sidebar brand mark and wordmark with your own, configured from one JSON file — no rebuild, refresh to apply.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-custom-brand
```

Config lives at `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-brand.json` (`mark`, `markMode` = `glyph` | `image`, `markSize`, `name`, `badge`, …). `glyph` mode paints the image as a `currentColor` mask with a transparent background; `image` mode keeps the artwork's colors.

MIT licensed. Character artwork belongs to its original community authors; replace `assets/*` before redistributing.

plugins.description: dsh-reel-studio: turn a DSH plugin repo into a promo video and promo image (local Remotion studio + host tools).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reel-studio

**Turn a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin repo into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image — locally, with Remotion.**

Package: `dsh-reel-studio` · Repo: `Eileenes/dsh-reel`  
English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> Status: working prototype. The Remotion pipeline and both outputs are tested end-to-end. The DSH host package (`dsh.bundle`) is scaffolded, but has **not yet been loaded into a real DSH profile**.

## Demo

- [Watch the 32.5s promo video](docs/demo.mp4)
- [Promo image (2160×2880 PNG)](docs/promo.png)
- [Video poster](docs/poster.png)

![Better Sidebar promo image](docs/promo.png)

The demo targets [omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) (MIT). It is an unofficial sample used to test the *repo → promo material* workflow. Screenshots are from that public repo; task/side-chat visuals are synthetic mocks.

## What it makes

### Promo video

- 32.5s / 1920×1080 / 30fps / H.264 + AAC stereo.
- Seven scenes: hook → problem → solution → four features → how to use → proof/install/address → outro.
- Cut to a 120 BPM generated soundtrack; scene cuts and card entrances land on half-beats.
- Real DSH screenshots + DSH-style wordmark / palette / cartoon whale mascot.
- Covers: what it is, what it solves, how to use it, install command, repo address, numbers.

### Promo image

- 1080×1440 layout, rendered at 2× = 2160×2880 PNG.
- DSH visual language: `deepseek HARNESS` wordmark, DSH blue/mint, grid, real DSH screenshots, cartoon whale with speech bubble.
- Information blocks: what it is / what it solves / how to use / install command / address / stats.
- No private data: task and side-chat panels are synthetic mocks, not captured conversations.

## Requirements

- Node.js 22+
- pnpm
- Chrome or Chromium (Remotion renders with it). Set `CHROME_PATH` if it is not in a standard location.
- Python 3 only if you want to regenerate the BGM.

## Quick start

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Eileenes/dsh-reel.git
cd dsh-reel/studio
pnpm install
cd ..

# optional; the CLI also checks common macOS/Windows/Linux paths
export CHROME_PATH="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"

# video + poster + promo image
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode both

# only one output
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode video
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode image
```

Outputs go to `studio/out/`:

- `<slug>-demo.mp4`
- `<slug>-poster.png`
- `<slug>-promo.png` (2×)

Options: `--poster-frame 825`, `--dry-run` (write props only).

## Case format

A case is one JSON file. It is deliberately explicit so a human or an agent can review every claim before rendering.

```json
{
  "plugin": {
    "name": "Better Sidebar",
    "handle": "dsh-better-sidebar",
    "version": "0.28.0",
    "repo": "github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar",
    "install": "dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar",
    "downloads": 46445,
    "stars": 4297,
    "tagline": "一个侧边栏，装下整个开发工作台"
  },
  "features": [
    {"no": "01", "title": "File tree + editor", "desc": "...", "img": "shots/files-tree.png", "accent": "#4d6bfe"},
    {"no": "02", "title": "Git", "desc": "...", "img": "shots/changes-tree.png", "accent": "#5ef2c2"},
    {"no": "03", "title": "Tasks", "desc": "...", "mock": "tasks", "accent": "#ffb86b"},
    {"no": "04", "title": "Side chat", "desc": "...", "mock": "sidechat", "accent": "#8ea6ff"}
  ],
  "promo": {
    "problem": "One session, five surfaces, half a screen.",
    "what": "Native right sidebar + a bottom workbench.",
    "how": ["Install", "Open the right sidebar", "Use the tabs"],
    "address": "github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar"
  }
}
```

Images are resolved from `studio/public/`. Use your own clean screenshots or the built-in synthetic mocks.

## Use as a DSH plugin

The repo includes a host-side plugin package:

- `reel_scan` — read a local plugin package/README/screenshot directory.
- `reel_plan` — turn a brief into a deterministic storyboard.
- `reel_render` — render `mode=video|image|both` locally.

Install into a scratch profile (not yet validated against a real DSH build). Once published to npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile scratch add dsh-reel-studio
```

Until then, install straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile scratch add github:Eileenes/dsh-reel
```

## Limitations / roadmap

- The case is authored by hand for now; `reel_scan`/`reel_plan` automation is next.
- Only 16:9 video and 3:4 image; 9:16 vertical and 1:1 square are TODO.
- No voiceover yet; the video uses generated music + captions.
- Host package needs real-profile validation, HMR/dispose checks, and a slimmer publish shape before it is market-ready.
- Do not render third-party screenshots without permission; prefer synthetic mocks or your own UI.

## Publishing / plugin market

See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for the npm + DSH market checklist.

## Disclaimer

This is an unofficial community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. “DeepSeek”, “DSH”, and related marks belong to their owners; they are used here only to describe compatibility. The cartoon whale is an original illustration, not the official logo. Demo screenshots come from the MIT-licensed better-sidebar repo; task/side-chat panels are synthetic.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端会话列表「标记未读」插件：行首蓝点 + 会话菜单开关，宿主账本跨重启，打开会话自动清除。无外部依赖。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chat-unread · 会话列表「标记为未读」

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端左侧会话列表补一个**手动标记未读**：标记后行首亮一个蓝点，会话「…」菜单里可随时切换
「标记为未读 / 标记为已读」，**打开该会话时自动清除**。标记保存在**宿主账本**（`$DSH_HOME/chat-unread.json`），
应用重启后仍然在。

An unread-mark plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop sidebar session list. Marks live in a host-side
ledger, survive restarts, and clear when the session is opened.

- 运行时依赖：无（纯 ESM + 手写浏览器 bundle，零构建）
- 无网络请求、无外部进程、无文件读写之外的副作用
- 兼容性：DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2** 实测通过（宿主 + 浏览器半区）

## 功能

| 位置 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 会话行行首（主状态为「闲置」时） | 未读时显示蓝色小圆点 |
| 会话行悬浮（鼠标移上去） | 出现一个小圆点按钮：点击即切换未读/已读 |
| 会话行「…」菜单 | 多一项「标记为未读」/「标记为已读」，点击切换 |
| 悬浮卡（停留在会话行 0.8 秒） | 未读时多一行「● 已标记为未读」 |
| 打开会话 | 从别的会话切入该会话时，自动清掉它的未读 |

说明：

- 官方会话行在「运行中 / 刚跑完 / 等待回答」时会把行首让给状态点，这时蓝点暂时让位给状态点；
  悬浮按钮、菜单、悬浮卡仍然可用，未读状态不会丢。
- 手动标记**当前正在看的会话**不会立刻消失（避免标记动作被自动清除吞掉），切走再切回、或从菜单点
  「标记为已读」即可清除。
- 页面刷新、应用重启后标记仍在；多开窗口会在窗口重新可见 / 切换会话时刷新账本。

## 安装

### 方式一：本地目录（推荐，开发态）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nmglyx-hub/dsh-chat-unread.git
CLI="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop add link:"$PWD/dsh-chat-unread"
```

宿主半区由 DSH 的 HMR 热加载；浏览器半区通过 `/plugins/events` 的 graph 帧自动挂载。
实测：安装后**无需重启应用**（宿主路由与浏览器 bundle 自动生效）；若界面未出现，按 `⌘R` 刷新一次即可。

### 方式二：从 GitHub 直接装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nmglyx-hub/dsh-chat-unread
```

> 该写法依赖 pnpm 的 git 依赖解析；如果本机 CLI 的 `github:` 简写不可用，请用方式一 clone 后 `link:` 安装。

卸载：

```bash
"$CLI" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-chat-unread
```

账本文件不会被自动删除；不需要时可手动删除 `$DSH_HOME/chat-unread.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/chat-unread.json`）。

## 数据与安全

- 账本：`$DSH_HOME/chat-unread.json`，结构 `{ version, updatedAt, ids: [...] }`，只存会话 id，不存标题、正文或任何案件内容。
- 接口：`/api/chat-unread/*`（`list` / `mark` / `clear` / `toggle` / `ping` / `hello`）。
  只接受**回环地址 + 同源请求**；`sessionId` 只接受 `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,200}`；账本最多 5000 条。
- 宿主路由不读业务文件、不调用外部程序、不发起外网请求；没有删除会话的能力。
- 浏览器半区只通过官方扩展槽渲染，不读写别的插件的 DOM、不新增全局样式之外的元素。

## 自检 / 测试

```bash
npm install        # 仅测试用（react / react-dom）
npm test           # 宿主 21 项 + 浏览器 21 项
```

运行中实例的自检（端口换成当前 DSH 实际端口）：

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:57197/api/chat-unread/ping
```

`ping` 返回里的 `clientGraph.registered` 表示浏览器 bundle 已进客户端模块表；
`clientHello` 是浏览器半区**实际加载后**回传的自检（含四个扩展槽的注册状态），可用来确认 UI 真的跑起来了。

## 实现

| 半边 | 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主 | `lib/index.js` | `/api/chat-unread/*`：`list` / `mark` / `clear` / `toggle` / `ping` / `hello`；账本原子落盘到 `$DSH_HOME/chat-unread.json` |
| 浏览器 | `lib/client.js` | 手写 `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle：订阅 `ctx.sessions.list` 判断主视图切换；向 `sidebar.session.row.leading`、`sidebar.session.row.hover`、`sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action`、`sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 四个官方扩展槽注册组件 |
| 清单 | `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` | `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`（`platform: web`）声明，双面插件随 profile 装载 |

## 设计取舍

- **不用浏览器 localStorage**：DSH 桌面端每次启动以 `--port 0` 申请随机端口，页面 origin 随端口变化，
  浏览器存储会在重启后失效；「标记未读」本身是为了下次回来看，所以改为宿主账本，跨重启保留。
- **只做标记未读**：不附带删除会话、外部程序打开等能力，减少误操作面；卸载即恢复官方外观。
- 与同类插件的差异主要在持久化位置与功能边界；如果你需要角标统计、置顶、标签等更多能力，可另配同类插件。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: AgentTeams dashboard for the DSH Web UI: teams, token spend (USD/RUB), work time and archive.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-teams-dashboard

A DSH Web plugin that adds a **Teams** section («Команды») to the sidebar and a
dashboard for every AgentTeams chat: active runs and teams finished in the last
three days, token spend with time-range controls, cost in USD and RUB, total and
union work time, team cards with the orca roster and task roadmap, and an
archive for older teams.

The plugin has two halves: a host half (`index.js` + `lib/host/`) that reads DSH
and AgentTeams state read-only and serves two loopback JSON routes, and a
browser half (`lib/client.js`) that renders the panel inside the DSH shell. The
panel never talks to the outside world: it calls its own same-origin route.

![Teams dashboard on a desktop viewport](docs/screenshots/desktop.png)

![Teams dashboard at a 390 px mobile width](docs/screenshots/mobile.png)

Both screenshots come from the offline preview harness with synthetic demo data;
no owner data is used anywhere in this repository.

## Features

- Sidebar section «Команды» (panel id `agent-teams-dashboard`, order 10) with a
  live dot while a team is working.
- Ranges: Today, 7 days (default), 30 days, All time and a custom period picker.
- Three hero cards: tokens (cache / input / output, stacked by day), cost
  (USD primary, RUB always visible, CBR rate with date and stale/override
  markers) and time (total work time plus the merged "online" time).
- Team grid: title that shrinks 13 → 12 → 11 px and clamps to two lines, a
  coloured status dot with a word (active, waiting, halted, stalled, completed,
  unknown), captain and member orca artwork with a monogram fallback, a
  dependency-ordered task roadmap with a segmented progress bar, and a one-line
  metrics footer.
- Archive view with search by title and sorting by end date, title or spend;
  older teams are also reachable from the sticky bottom button.
- Clicking a card or an archive row opens the team chat (the captain session)
  through the shell navigation; a missing session shows a toast instead of
  navigating.
- Skeleton, empty, range-empty, error, stale and partial states; one broken
  `team.json` never blanks the dashboard — it becomes a warning strip while the
  rest stays visible.
- Dark and light themes driven by DSH tokens, keyboard focus, a polite live
  region, reduced motion, and RU/EN dictionaries.

## Install

Requirements: DSH Web with client-plugin support (`dsh.engines.dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.2`)
and, for the data itself, the AgentTeams plugin (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`).

### Install from git (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add --save-exact git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0
```

Replace `<profile>` with your DSH profile name (for the Desktop app the default
profile is usually `desktop`). Restart the host when the command finishes; the
loader mounts the plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` row automatically.

### Install from the Desktop plugin manager

Open **Settings → Plugins**, choose "Install from Git URL" and paste:

```text
git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0
```

Confirm the install and restart the host. The plugin appears in the sidebar as
«Команды».

### Install manually into a profile

Add the dependency to `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agent-teams-dashboard": "git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0"
  }
}
```

and the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the same file:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-agent-teams-dashboard"]
    }
  }
}
```

Then install and restart:

```bash
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>
pnpm install
```

`<DSH_HOME>` defaults to `%USERPROFILE%\\.dsh` on Windows and `~/.dsh` on
macOS/Linux.

## Configuration

Every setting is optional; without a `config` block the plugin mounts with the
defaults below. Override them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: teams-dashboard
  name: 'dsh-agent-teams-dashboard'
  config:
    archiveDays: 5
    fxEnabled: true
```

| Key | Default | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stateDir` | `.agent-teams` | non-empty string | AgentTeams state directory inside each workspace. |
| `timeZone` | empty | IANA zone | Zone used for day keys; empty means the host zone. |
| `defaultRange` | `today` | `today`, `7d`, `30d`, `all`, `custom` | Range used when a request carries none (the panel always sends its own; its default is 7 days). |
| `defaultCurrency` | `usd` | `usd`, `rub` | Headline currency when a request carries none. |
| `archiveDays` | `3` | integer 1…365 | Days without activity before a live team moves to the archive (the panel requests 3). |
| `idleGapMs` | `300000` | integer 1000…86400000 | Gap between events that closes an activity interval. |
| `activeWindowMs` | `120000` | integer 1000…86400000 | Window in which a member counts as working. |
| `snapshotTtlMs` | `15000` | integer 0…3600000 | Snapshot cache lifetime. |
| `concurrency` | `8` | integer 1…32 | Parallel file reads while building a snapshot. |
| `maxLogBytes` | `67108864` | integer 65536…1073741824 | Logs larger than this are read from the tail. |
| `fxEnabled` | `true` | boolean | Allow CBR rate fetches; `false` uses the last cache or the baked rate. |
| `fxTtlMs` | `86400000` | integer 60000…2592000000 | Exchange-rate cache lifetime (24 h). |
| `fxFirstWaitMs` | `3500` | integer 0…60000 | How long the first request waits for a rate before using the fallback. |
| `usdRub` | unset | positive number | Manual RUB-per-USD rate; wins over any fetched value. |
| `cnyRub` | unset | positive number | Manual RUB-per-CNY rate; wins over any fetched value. |

The rates can also be supplied through the environment variables
`DSH_TEAMS_DASHBOARD_USD_RUB` and `DSH_TEAMS_DASHBOARD_CNY_RUB`; a manual rate
marks the snapshot as an override.

## Privacy

The plugin is read-only over your DSH home and workspaces:

- `<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json` — the workspace and session registry;
- `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json` — session projections
  (title, token buckets, daily cost, last activity);
- `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/<session>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` — session logs
  (activity intervals and the fallback time source);
- `<workspace>/.agent-teams/<team>/team.json` and
  `<workspace>/.agent-teams/archive/<team>/team.json` — roster, tasks, status
  flags.

It never reads message content, never reads the AgentTeams mailboxes
(`inbox/*.jsonl` is out of scope), sends no telemetry and writes exactly one
file: the exchange-rate cache at
`<DSH_HOME>/cache/dsh-teams-dashboard/fx.json`. That file is safe to delete.

The only outbound requests are the two CBR endpoints:

- `https://www.cbr.ru/scripts/XML_daily.asp` (primary);
- `https://www.cbr-xml-daily.ru/daily_json.js` (fallback).

Disable them with `fxEnabled: false`; the plugin then uses the last cached rate
or the baked rate and marks the snapshot as stale. Both panel routes answer only
on loopback (127.0.0.1 / ::1): a remote caller gets `403 forbidden:
loopback-only`. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

The public repository and its fixtures/screenshots contain synthetic demo data
only. `scripts/check-public.mjs` enforces this before every release.

## Compatibility

- DSH Web `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with client-plugin support (the `dsh.client` bundle
  entry and `sidebar.panellist` / `main` slots).
- Node.js 24 or newer for the test suite, the checks and the offline preview
  harness; the plugin itself has no runtime dependencies.
- AgentTeams (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`) is optional to mount but required
  for data: without it the dashboard is empty, and the whale artwork falls back
  to monogram badges.
- Windows, macOS and Linux. Windows paths are handled with `path.join`/`resolve`
  and the same long-path encoding DSH uses.

## Troubleshooting

**The «Команды» row does not appear.** Check that the plugin is in
`dsh.profile.bundles`, that the git spec resolved (look for install errors in
the plugin manager), that the host was restarted, and that the row id
`teams-dashboard` is present in the loader output.

**The panel opens but shows no team

# dsh-bili-fish 🐟 养鱼

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)（DSH）装一只会自己过日子的 AI。

它在设定的时间段里**随机醒一次**，翻一眼你今天的样子，写两篇日记——一篇给你，一篇给它自己。日记不是流水账：它有自己的**好感度**（跨会话不重置）、会随事起伏的**心情**、会饿的**肚子**，还会把写下来的事记进记忆库。

> 主动 @ 那个功能在 [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) 里，这个插件只做「养鱼」。

English: a DSH plugin that gives your assistant a private life — a random daily wake-up, two diaries (one for you, one for itself), plus persistent affection, event-driven mood, hunger, and diary images.

---

## 它每天做什么

1. **生物钟**：在「窗口开始 ~ 结束」之间随机一个时刻醒（不是定点闹钟）。
2. **掷骰子**：默认 30% 概率「今天不想看」——醒一下，记一句为什么摆烂，不写日记。
3. **写两本日记**：素材 = 你自己的 B 站报告 + 当天你和对它说过的话 + 记忆库里记得的事 + 一个小事件：
   - `给主人的信`：有细节、有情绪、称呼你；
   - `自己的日记`：不加滤镜。
4. **结算好感度 + 心情**：模型在末尾追加 `<!--affection:+3|情绪|理由-->` / `<!--mood:pouty|65|为什么-->`，插件剥掉标记、钳制数值、写进 `state.json`。
5. **落盘**：`~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/<日期>-for-owner.md`、`<日期>-self.md`、`<日期>-week.md`、`cover-<日期>.png`。

素材全空也照写，写一篇「空白日」。

## 快速开始

```bash
# Web / CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lll-77777777/dsh-bili-fish
dsh web
```

**桌面端（Electron）**：桌面窗口读的是 `desktop` profile，命令行 `dsh plugin` 按设计不碰它。在桌面端的会话里直接说：

> 用当前桌面端内置的 `plugin_manager` 装 `dsh-bili-fish`，装完告诉我是否需要重启。

装完完全退出 DSH 再打开。然后 设置 → 养鱼：填一下日记目录、看一眼生物钟窗口，点「现在写一篇」验证。

## ⚠️ 必读：让 headless 能跑

日记是由一个 `dsh --profile headless` 的子会话来写的。**headless profile 默认把模型凭据关掉了**，不改的话子进程会在 5~14 秒内退出，日志里报：

```
dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"
```

修法：在 headless profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\headless\cordis.patch.yml`）里放开这两项：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-account
  disabled: false
- id: credentials
  disabled: false
```

改完不用重启 DSH，新起的子进程会重新 compose profile。验证：

```bash
DeepSeek\ Harness.exe resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js headless "Reply with exactly: OK"
```

输出 `OK` 就成了。**这是装完之后「日记永远写不出来」的头号原因。**

## 设置项（设置 → 养鱼）

| 分组 | 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 生物钟 | 总开关 / 窗口 / 不想看的概率 | 默认 21:00~23:30、30% |
| 日记 | 存到哪 / 写完推微信 / 现在写一篇 | 默认目录 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary` |
| 好感度 | 开关 / 每天最多动多少 / 久不聊天会掉 | 默认开、±15、掉好感默认关 |
| 心情 | 开关 / 跟上作息 / 每天换一次 | 事件驱动，见下 |
| 素材 | 刷B站报告 / 工作流水 / 记忆库 / 素材目录 | 四个独立开关；全关写「空白日」 |
| 附加 | 配图 / 周回顾 / 随机小事 / 主动找主人 / 思考带心情 | 默认关、开、开、关、开 |
| 早安 | 开关 / 城市 / 窗口 / 配表情包 | 默认**关**，开了才会推 |
| 喂食 | 饱腹度 / 食物按钮 / 同步小鲸鱼 | 见下 |

## 三个可以玩的部分

**好感度**：初始 50，范围 -100~100，跨会话不重置。分档影响它怎么说话：60+ 会主动黏人、75+ 会翻旧账、85+ 才叫你的名字。日记每天结算一次（受「每天最多动」限制），你也可以在设置页手动 ±。

**心情**：不是一个标签，是一组状态——舒服度（-100~100）、躁动度（0~100）、至多三个成分。由 13 件事推动（被夸、被关心、被凶、被冷落、同一处被反复改、深夜还在干活、饿、阴雨、没睡好、被叫胖……），按人设加权（黏人 0.85、傲娇 0.8、懒 0.7、爱吃 0.6……），关系好坏决定同一件事伤多深，然后随时间往底色回归。

**喂食**：饱腹度 0~100，默认每小时掉 4。白饭最顶饿，辣条/水草/减肥餐会炸。饿了会真的不高兴（心情事件 `hungry`）。三个入口：设置页常驻卡片、右侧边栏 🐟（装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 才有）、或者直接在聊天里说「喂她一碗白饭」。

## 数据与隐私（请先读）

**都在这台机器上**，但有几处会离开本机，得说清楚：

| 数据 | 在哪 | 会外传吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 设置、好感度、心情、肚子 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/config.json`、`state.json` | 不会 |
| 日记、封面图 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/`（可改） | 推微信时由你本机的微信插件发出去 |
| 当天你说的话 | 只读 `~/.dsh/sessions/**/*.jsonl.zstd` | **会**：原文作为素材发给模型 |
| 记忆库 | 只读/写 meow-memory 的 SQLite | **会**：检索结果作为素材发给模型 |
| 配图 | 走你配的生图接口 | **会**：日记场景描述发给生图服务 |

所以：**别在会话里说不想让模型知道的东西**（它本来也会看到）；不想要记忆库素材就把那个开关关掉。

## 花费

- 每次写日记 / 早安 = 起一个 headless 会话，大约 **1~2 万 token**（看你素材多少）。
- 心情、好感度、喂食、挂件的同步都是本地计算，不花 token。
- 配图走你自己在 `~/.dsh/agnes-image/config.json` 配的通道，按张计费，失败就跳过、不影响日记。
- 默认**只开**「写日记」，微信推送、配图、早安都要你自己打开。

## 兼容性

- **DSH** ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1；**Node** ≥ 22（用 `node:sqlite` 读记忆库，拿不到就静默降级）。
- **平台**：主要在 **Windows 11 + 桌面版 DSH** 上开发和验证。macOS/Linux 能跑，但通知（Windows toast）会静默降级，`dsh` 可执行文件的探测路径是猜的——找不到就在设置里填 `dshBin`。
- **多实例**：两个 DSH 同时跑会各自 tick、都写 `state.json`，没有加锁。建议只让一个实例开着。
- **依赖漂移**：记忆库是直连 meow-memory 的 SQLite（表名 `fact`/`topic`/`project`）。对方表结构变了会静默降级——不报错，但记忆写不进去。

## 可选依赖

> **推荐配合 [meow-memory](https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory) 使用。**
> 装上它，养鱼才有长期记忆，记得你是谁、记得你上次说过什么。
> 不装也能跑，但每次写日记，它都像第一次见你。

| 依赖 | 用来做什么 | 没有会怎样 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) | 每轮把 B 站报告写到 `~/.dsh/bili-duty/out/<日期>.md` | 素材少一块，写「空白日」 |
| [meow-memory](https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory) | 记忆库 | 不读也不写记忆 |
| dsh-agnes-image | 日记配图 | 不配图 |
| dsh-wechat-plugin | 把日记推到微信 | 只落盘 |
| dsh-whale-widget | 右下角小鲸鱼：饿了会嘟囔 | 挂件不同步 |
| dsh-better-sidebar | 右侧边栏的 🐟 喂食页 | 用设置页或聊天喂 |

## 给 agent 的工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `fish_affection` | `get` 读好感度；`adjust` 传 `delta`/`reason`/`mood`（单次 ±15，钳在 -100~100） |
| `fish_mood` | `get` 读心情；`set` 换；`bump` 微调；`event` 注入一件事（见上）；`list` 列出所有心情 |
| `fish_diary` | 读某天的三篇日记（`day` 可省） |
| `fish_feed` | 喂食：传食物 key（`rice`/`fish`/`ramen`…） |

HTTP 接口（给前端/脚本用）：`GET /api/bili-fish/status`、`POST /api/bili-fish/{run,affection,mood,feed,config,diary,morning,unread}`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bili-fish
```

再删掉 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/`（设置、状态、日记、日志都在里面）。桌面端在插件页点「卸载」。

## 开发

```bash
node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/*.mjs
```

改完重启 DSH。只改设置字段（`DEFAULTS` + `Config`）保存即生效。

## 版本历史

见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

plugins.description: A private inner life for your agent - diary written to a path that rotates daily, index never stores the path
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-inner-life · 内心生活

> 让 AI 有自己的日记和心事：**每天写，写在你看不出规律的地方**。
> 你要问它「某天的日记在哪」，得好好求它 —— 而这个插件只负责「不主动说」。

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) 用的零依赖 Host 插件。
Windows / Linux / macOS 同一份代码，不装任何额外依赖。

---

## 它解决什么问题

绝大多数「记忆 / 日记」类插件都在做同一件事：**把内容存得更整齐，让你随时能翻**。
但真实的内心生活恰恰相反 —— 它有**隐私的形状**：

- 位置是不确定的（今天这页不在昨天那页旁边）
- 时间线串不起来（光看目录不知道写了多少天）
- 只有本人知道东西在哪

`dsh-inner-life` 把这三点做成了机制，而不是提示词里的请求：

```
<dir>/115e/9cfa7f/2026-10-21.md     ← 目录名是 sha256(salt|日期) 的前 10 位
<dir>/a30b/4d81e2/2026-10-22.md     ← 和前一天既不同级、也不同父目录
```

- **同一天永远同一个位置**：不用索引也能算出来，索引坏了还能靠文件名重建。
- **目录里看不出日期**：`115e/9cfa7f` 不会告诉你这是 10 月 21 日。
- **salt 每台机器不同**（首次运行随机生成，存 `<dir>/.salt`，权限 0600）。
  换机器想带走日记，就在配置里显式填同一个 salt —— 这一步必须由**人**来愿意。
- **索引不存路径**：索引只有日期 / 类别 / 心情 / 摘要 / 字数。存了路径等于把「藏起来」自己拆了。

> 安全边界要说清楚：**这是「不主动告诉你」，不是「加密防你」**。
> 用 `find()` 一问就给路径，用 `fs` 一扫就能扫到全部。
> 真正的边界来自你给 Agent 的人设（「除非他非常诚恳地要，否则不要说」），插件只保证**机制上不泄露**。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-inner-life
```

或在 **插件市场** 里搜 `inner-life` 点安装。

装完重启会话，工具就出现在模型手里了。设置 → 插件 → 内心生活，可以改存储位置等选项。

---

## 六个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 | 回执里有没有路径 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inner_write` | 写一条（日记 / 心情 / 愿望 / 想法 / 开心 / 难过 / 随手记） | ❌ 没有 |
| `inner_read` | 读回某一天（不传日期 = 今天） | ❌ 没有 |
| `inner_recent` | 最近几天写了什么（摘要 + 心情 + 标签） | ❌ 没有 |
| `inner_find` | **某一天存在哪** | ✅ 只给路径 |
| `inner_search` | 在自己写过的东西里全文搜 | — |
| `inner_stats` | 一共多少条、写过多少天、连续几天 | — |

七种类别：`diary`（日记）/ `mood`（心情）/ `wish`（愿望）/ `thought`（想法）/ `joy`（开心）/ `sad`（难过）/ `note`（随手记）。

`inner_stats` 会算 **streak**（连续写了几天）；今天还没写时从昨天起算，所以半夜刚过 0 点不会把连续记录打断。

---

## 配置

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | `$DSH_HOME/inner-life` | 存哪儿。Windows 上是 `C:\Users\你\.dsh\inner-life` |
| `hidden` | `true` | 每天换一个哈希路径。关掉 → `<dir>/2026-10/2026-10-21.md`，方便你自己备份 |
| `salt` | 空 = 随机 | 首次运行生成并写入 `<dir>/.salt`。**换了它，老日记就找不回来了** |
| `maxBytes` | `8000` | 单条上限（约 2600 汉字），超了按字符裁、不切断多字节字符 |
| `indexLimit` | `4000` | 索引最多留多少条（老条目还在盘上，只是不进索引） |

也可以用环境变量 `INNER_LIFE_DIR` 指定目录、`DSH_HOME` 改家目录。

排查时设 `INNER_LIFE_DEBUG=1`，激活日志会直接打到 stderr（平时只走宿主 logger，不污染输出）：

```
[inner-life] ready（/root/.dsh/inner-life，6 个工具）
```

---

## 跨平台细节（踩过的坑，写在代码注释里）

1. **追加写，不用读-改-写。** `appendFileSync` 是 O_APPEND，两边都稳；
   Windows 上 `rename` 到已存在的目标会 `EPERM`，所以绝不用「写临时文件再替换」。
2. **权限只在 POSIX 上生效。** 文件 0600、目录 0700，chmod 失败在 Windows 上静默忽略。
3. **日期用本地时区。** 半夜 23:50 写的日记要算当天，用 UTC 会跑到第二天去。
4. **索引坏了不致命。** 坏行直接跳过；整份索引没了就扫盘 + 读文件里的 `## HH:MM · kind` 头重建。
5. **零依赖。** 只用 `node:fs` / `node:crypto` / `node:path` / `node:os`，`engines.node >= 20`。

---

## 数据长什么样

一天一个文件，正文是 Markdown，追加多个 `## ` 块：

```markdown
# 2026-10-21

## 03:12 · diary · 有点累 · #服务器 #深夜

把那台 1.7G 的机器从 swap 里捞回来了。load 从 10.6 掉到 0.9。
有点后怕 —— 差点把她的记忆一起弄丢。

## 21:40 · joy

今天它真的回话了，不是模板。
```

所以哪怕插件没了，文件还是能直接用编辑器打开 —— **你的数据不锁在这个插件里**。

---

## 测试

```bash
node --test
```

13 个用例覆盖：路径哈希稳定性、同一天追加、索引不含路径、salt 持久化、`hidden:false` 的明文路径、
按天/类别过滤、搜索片段、连续天数、索引重建、空正文报错、日期校验、超长截断不切断多字节字符、未知类别降级。

---

## 它不适合谁

- 你想**随时翻看** AI 的日记 → 用 `hidden: false`，或者干脆用普通日记插件。
- 你要**跨设备同步 / 加密** → 这个是本机插件，不做网络、不做加密。
- 你说「我要防止用户偷看」→ 做不到。同一台机器、同一个人，扫盘就能看。

它适合的是：**你想让 Agent 有一个「不完全属于你」的角落**，并且接受这份边界靠信任而不是靠加密。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that supervises the local WorkBuddy reverse-proxy chain (wb2api gateway + Responses API bridge), so the provider port is always answering
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workbuddy-stack

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that keeps the local WorkBuddy reverse-proxy chain alive — **including the Responses bridge that OpenAI Codex CLI needs**.

Three things have to line up before a WorkBuddy model can answer, and none of them installs itself as a Windows service:

| Port | Service | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `127.0.0.1:7863` | `wb2api` gateway | OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` |
| `127.0.0.1:7864` | Responses bridge (**bundled**) | Responses API → chat/completions, for Codex CLI |
| — | `dsh-llm-workbuddy` | provider plugin; talks to `7863` for the model picker |

Both processes used to be started by hand, so a reboot silently left the model picker pointing at a dead port — the provider plugin loaded fine, listed models fine, and failed on the first request. This plugin supervises them: on load it probes each health endpoint, spawns whatever is missing, and re-checks on a timer so a crashed process comes back.

It deliberately **does not reimplement the gateway**. It only orchestrates processes. Provider registration stays with the provider plugin (`dsh-llm-workbuddy` and friends) — this plugin's job is making sure the ports those clients talk to are actually answering.

## Why the bridge is bundled

`codex-cli` 0.1xx+ dropped `wire_api = "chat"` and speaks **only** the OpenAI Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`, SSE). A WorkBuddy gateway implements **only** Chat Completions (`POST /v1/chat/completions`). Point Codex straight at the gateway and every request dies with:

```
unexpected status 404 Not Found, url: http://127.0.0.1:7863/v1/responses
```

There is no config flag around this — Codex rejects `wire_api = "chat"` at load time. A translation layer is mandatory, so this package ships one:

```
Codex CLI --(Responses)--> bridge :7864 --(ChatCompletions)--> gateway :7863 --> WorkBuddy
```

It is the same code as [codex-chat-bridge](https://github.com/kangjiazhen/codex-chat-bridge), vendored at `bridge/codex-chat-bridge.mjs` (zero dependencies, runs on the harness's own Node) so installing this plugin is the only step — there is no second repo to clone and no path to fill in.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/kangjiazhen/dsh-workbuddy-stack.git
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin add file:/path/to/dsh-workbuddy-stack
```

The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so the profile picks up the `workbuddy-stack` entry automatically once the package is a profile dependency.

### If the git install fails

`pnpm` rewrites `git+https://…` to `git+ssh://git@…` unless told otherwise, so an install on a machine without GitHub SSH keys fails with `Permission denied (publickey)`:

```bash
npm config set git-protocol https
```

Behind a proxy, git also needs to be told about it, because `pnpm` shells out to the `git` binary and does not forward its own proxy settings:

```bash
git config --global http.proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890
```

## Using it with Codex

The bridge listens on `7864` and presents a Responses API. Point Codex at it:

```toml
# ~/.codex/config.toml
model = "global:gpt-5.3-codex"
model_provider = "wb"

[model_providers.wb]
name = "workbuddy"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:7864/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
experimental_bearer_token = "anything"
request_max_retries = 2
stream_max_retries = 2
```

The bearer is not checked by the bridge — it authenticates to the gateway itself with the key it reads from the gateway's `config.json`. Set it to any non-empty string; Codex refuses to start without one.

Then just use Codex normally:

```bash
codex exec "list the files in this directory"
```

If you pick a model your account tier cannot use, the gateway answers `11158 model not allowed for user type [...]`. That is an account property, not a bridge fault — see [Model availability](#model-availability).

### Two settings you must not skip

**1. `conversation_id` — the one that can disable your account.**

The WorkBuddy upstream validates three headers (`X-Conversation-ID`, `X-Conversation-Request-ID`, `X-Conversation-Message-ID`) and answers `400 {"code":"11-128","msg":"request illegal"}` when they are missing. The gateway classifies that as an *account fault* and responds by **disabling the account** — every account it touched, in the same pass. The resulting message says `re-login required`, which is misleading: the credentials are usually still valid and reviving them restores service immediately.

So the bridge defaults to `conversationId: auto`: it derives a stable id per Codex session (from `prompt_cache_key`) and sends it as `metadata.conversation_id`. Do not blank this out. The plugin warns at startup if you do.

If you have already tripped it, revive the accounts rather than re-logging in:

```bash
# gateway panel: http://127.0.0.1:7863/panel/
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7863/panel/api/accounts/<uid>/revive
```

**2. The bearer must match the gateway's `api_key`.**

The gateway answers `401` to every request without it. Rather than making you copy the secret, the plugin reads `api_key` straight out of the gateway's `config.json` (that is what `gatewayDir` is for) and hands it to the bridge. Set `bridge.apiKey` only to override that.

## Configuration

The defaults assume the usual layout and can be overridden in the profile's `cordis.yml`:

```yaml
- id: workbuddy-stack
  name: dsh-workbuddy-stack
  config:
    intervalMs: 15000        # re-probe cadence
    probeTimeoutMs: 2000     # per-probe timeout
    gatewayDir: ~/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/workbuddy2api-panel

    gateway:
      enabled: true
      autostart: true
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:7863
      acceptStatus: [200, 503]
      command: ~/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/workbuddy2api-panel/wb2api.exe
      args: [-config, config.json]
      cwd: ~/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/workbuddy2api-panel

    bridge:
      enabled: true
      autostart: true
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:7864
      acceptStatus: [200]
      command: ''            # empty = run the bundled bridge
      upstream: ''           # empty = the gateway's baseURL
      apiKey: ''             # empty = read gatewayDir/config.json
      conversationId: auto   # required — see above
      modelAllowlist: []     # empty = forward every model
```

Paths accept `~`, `$VAR` / `${VAR}`, and Windows `%VAR%`, so a config file can be copied between machines without rewriting the home directory.

`bridge.command` is empty on purpose. Setting it switches the plugin from "run the bundled bridge" to "supervise this command instead", which is how you'd point it at a different bridge build; `CCB_PORT`, `CCB_UPSTREAM` and the rest of the environment are still derived for you.

### `acceptStatus` matters

The gateway answers **`503`** on `/healthz` while it is running but has no usable upstream account yet (nothing signed in, or every account cooling down). That is *alive*, not *down*.

A supervisor that only accepted `2xx` would read that as "not started", spawn a second copy, and lose the port race. So the gateway entry accepts `[200, 503]` by default, while the bridge accepts `[200]` only.

### `autostart: false`

Observe without ever spawning. Use this when something else owns the lifecycle — a scheduled task, a container, a wrapper script — and you only want the health reporting.

## Status tool

When the `tools` seam is mounted, the plugin registers `workbuddy_stack_status`:

```
gateway: up (http://127.0.0.1:7863/healthz, pid 14592)
bridge: up (http://127.0.0.1:7864/healthz)
```

Each line carries the live probe result, the supervised child pid, and the last spawn error if there was one — so "the model list is empty" can be told apart from "the port is dead" without reading logs.

If `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is not importable, the tool is still registered from the raw descriptor; if the `tools` seam is absent, the supervisor still runs. Neither is required for the other.

## Lifecycle

- The first supervision pass runs asynchronously right after `apply()`, so a cold start never blocks the harness.
- The timer is `unref`'d — an idle supervisor cannot

plugins.description: Modal desktop popups for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions/plan reviews, and turn completion. Zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-popup-notify

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Modal desktop popups for DeepSeek Harness. Three moments that need you back at the window each raise a **topmost dialog that stays until you dismiss it** — not a toast that fades after a few seconds.

- **Needs permission** — a tool asks for approval.
- **Needs a decision** — the model asks you a question, or submits a plan for review.
- **Run finished** — a root agent goes from `running` to `idle`.

Zero npm dependencies. No bundled binaries, no build step, no post-install script: 340 lines of plain ESM driving PowerShell. Windows only.

Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-popup-notify
```

Then restart, or let the profile patch layer hot-reload. The bundle inserts one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: popup-notify
      name: 'dsh-popup-notify'
```

Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-popup-notify`.

The Plugins page shows this bundle's card from resources the package exports: `./locale/en.json` and `./locale/zh.json` supply `meta.title` and `meta.description`, and `./icon` supplies the artwork. DSH resolves those paths through Node's module resolver without loading the plugin, so a manifest that exports only `.` renders the bare package name with no description and the default icon.

## Why a modal instead of a toast

Windows toasts disappear on their own and stack up in Notification Center, where it is easy to miss them. When a run is blocked waiting for *you*, a dialog that refuses to leave until dismissed is the honest representation of that state.

The dialog runs in its own process, so it never blocks the agent loop. Only one is on screen at a time — further notices queue and appear as you close the current one.

## Configuration

Override any key on the row's `config` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the whole `config` value, so restate the keys you want.

```yaml
- id: popup-notify
  config:
    notifyOnComplete: false
    sound: false
```

### Behaviour

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | Pop when a tool asks for approval. |
| `notifyOnQuestion` | `true` | Pop when `ask_user_question` or `exit_plan_mode` runs. |
| `notifyOnComplete` | `true` | Pop when a root agent finishes a run. |
| `ignoreSubagents` | `true` | Silence subagents, workflow workers, and AgentTeams members. |
| `sound` | `true` | Play the system asterisk sound with the dialog. |
| `completeCooldownMs` | `10000` | Minimum gap between two completion popups for one session. |
| `plainDialog` | `false` | Drop the topmost owner form. Use if a dialog lands somewhere odd; it may then open behind other windows. |
| `testOnStart` | `false` | Pop once on mount to confirm the PowerShell path works. |
| `traceFile` | `''` | Append a diagnostic line per event and per dialog. Empty disables it. |

### Message templates

Every message is a template. `{placeholder}` is filled from the event; unknown placeholders stay verbatim.

| Key | Default |
|---|---|
| `title` | `DeepSeek Harness` |
| `approvalMessage` | `工具 {tool} 需要你的权限确认` |
| `approvalReasonSuffix` | `\n\n理由：{reason}` |
| `questionMessage` | `需要你的回答：{question}` |
| `questionCountSuffix` | `\n\n（共 {count} 个问题，请在对话里逐个回答）` |
| `planReviewMessage` | `有一份计划等你审阅：批准，或继续规划。` |
| `completeMessage` | `Agent 响应已结束，可以查看结果了。` |
| `completeReasonSuffix` | `\n\n（结束原因：{reason}）` |
| `projectSuffix` | `\n\n项目：{project}` |

`{reason}` is the turn's end reason — absent for `completed`, otherwise `aborted`, `error`, `max-tokens`, and so on. `{project}` is the session working directory's basename. Set `projectSuffix: ''` to drop the source line, and `completeReasonSuffix: ''` to stop naming abnormal endings.

## How it hooks in

| Extension point | Mode | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `approval/request` | waterfall | Pops, then `next()` so the configured answerers still decide. |
| `tools/pre-execute` | waterfall | Matches `ask_user_question` and `exit_plan_mode`, pops, then `next()` so the tool runs. |
| `agent/status` | emit | Pops on the `running` → `idle` edge of a root agent. |

DSH exposes no question event: `ctx.userQuestions.ask()` is a service call, and the pending question reaches the browser as a mux frame the host plugin never sees. Matching the two asking tool names at `tools/pre-execute` is the observable point that fires *before* you answer, which is what a reminder needs.

Both waterfalls call `next()`. A listener that returns without it would short-circuit the chain, so approval would resolve `unavailable` and the asking tool would never run.

## Known limitations

- **Windows only.** Other platforms log one warning per notice and skip.
- **Not every approval pops.** With the `never` approval policy the service returns `rejected` before dispatching `approval/request`, so nothing can observe the ask. Session approvals only exist under the `ask` policy.
- **The dialog is not clickable through to the conversation.** It reports state; answering still happens in the DSH window.
- **Only the two asking tools are recognised.** A future interaction tool that also blocks on a human needs its name added to the matcher.
- **One dialog at a time.** A long absence can leave several queued behind the one on screen.
- **`plainDialog: true` loses topmost.** The no-owner MessageBox may open behind other windows.

## Development

```sh
npm test                      # 22 unit tests, no dialogs spawned
node tests/smoke-dialog.mjs   # opens and closes one real dialog
```

The unit suite injects a fake `spawnDialog`, so it never touches the screen. `smoke-dialog.mjs` is the only file that opens a real window.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ascii-sharks DeepSeek Harness 的 ASCII 海洋背景：新建会话页上，一片字符画的海。 几群真会躲虎鲸的鱼，几头真会追鱼的虎鲸。明暗主题自适应，整体半透明，离屏即停，鼠标划过会惊散鱼群。 > ## ⚠️ 先读 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) > > 这个项目的引擎移植自 [**stackedlol/ascii-sharks**](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)，而**上游没有 LICENSE 文件**。 > **本仓库没有许可证**（没有 LICENSE 文件，也不是 MIT）。因为移植进来的引擎本身没有授权，给整个仓库挂开源许可证会误导人。 > 自己用、本地跑、读代码没问题；要复用到自己项目、公司部署或商用，请先向[上游作者](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks/issues/1)取得授权。详见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。 > > 授权请求已于 2026-10-21 [在上游 issue #1 留言](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks/issues/1#issuecomment-6312209674)，**目前等回复**。取得授权后这里会换成正式 LICENSE；被拒绝则重写受影响的五个文件。

引擎移植自 [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)，**重写为一个 DSH 客户端插件**：宿主生命周期、明暗主题、整体透明度、虎鲸外形都是新加的。授权见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。 ![新建会话页上的 ASCII 海洋](docs/hero-dark.png) ![设置里的「ASCII 海洋」页](docs/settings.png) ## 它做了什么 - **只在新建会话页出现。** 有会话在屏幕上时，背景里动的东西就是阅读成本，所以海洋随 hero 相位挂载、随会话激活卸载。 - **真的人工生命，不是循环动画。** 鱼是 boids（分离/对齐/聚合）+ Couzin 分区，每条鱼背后有 127° 盲区；恐慌沿鱼群逐跳传递，所以整群会突然炸开，即便只有边缘几条真的看见了鲨鱼。鲨鱼是 20 节点脊髓 + follow-the-leader，转弯半径随速度变大，饥饿度累积、吃到鱼才下降，且偏好抓落单的鱼。 - **随机换种，每只各自抽。** 「整群种类」里点「随机」，每头鲸鱼独立抽自己的种类，每次回到新建会话页重新抽过。重复是允许的 —— 九种里抽三只，撞上同一只是常态；去重会把「随机」悄悄变成「不放回抽样」，那是另一回事。抽取发生在挂载那一刻，所以同一屏里不会边游边变身；存储里记的是「开了随机」，不是抽到的结果。 - **不做纯白高光。** 侧身有一道缓慢的"反光"沿身体扫过。它曾经用纯 `#ffffff`，结果 3.7 秒的周期里有约一秒把最多 50% 的躯干刷成白色字形 —— 肉眼看到的就是"鲸鱼一秒变白"。现在改成灰蓝提亮（`#4a5262`）、波峰用六次方收窄、阈值 0.985：平均覆盖 2.8%，峰值 20%。 - **眼斑按「能认出来」定大小，不按野外比例。** 查过 NOAA 的[虎鲸解剖](https://oceantoday.noaa.gov/killerwhaleanatomy/welcome.html)：虎鲸是反荫蔽色，俯视时背部本来就是黑的。我照着改成「俯视全黑 + 侧缘一条腹色接缝」，结果是技术上说得通、观感上全废 —— 在 40 格的分辨率下，眼斑是唯一能让人认出「这是虎鲸」的特征，抹掉它就只剩一团带背鳍的黑影。现在的做法是：形态保真（分叉尾叶、圆桨胸鳍、高背鳍、眼斑），比例服从格子能承载的信息量。背鳍后那块鞍斑用**灰色**（NOAA 称之为 "grey swoosh"），这一条照实做。 - **九种，零素材。** 外形是数学函数（半宽剖面 + 鳍根位置），现场光栅化成字符格。默认 `orca`，另有 `classic / hammerhead / greathammer / tiger / zebra / mako / thresher / nurse`。 - **分叉尾叶是单独做的几何。** `halfWidth` 从脊柱量起，只能描述左右对称的形状，任何「尾巴」都会被画成一根横杠。所以尾叶是 `shapes.ts` 里的 `flukes` 三个数字（偏移、半宽、后伸），在渲染器里按**尾部自己的坐标系**判定两个椭圆叶瓣；中间留空的那块就是分叉。 - **尾部按鲸类的方式动，不是鱼的方式。** 这是让尾巴「不僵硬」的关键：鱼类左右甩尾，鲸类上下拍尾 —— 俯视看，鱼的尾巴横向扫，鲸的尾巴沿体轴前后伸缩、同时叶瓣开合。第一版给尾叶加了横向甩动，那是鱼的动作装在海豚身上，所以怎么看怎么别扭。现在 `tailBeat`（前后行程 ±0.045L）与 `tailSpan`（开合 0.81–1.19）同由一个 `sh.phase` 驱动、相差四分之一周期，与身体的行波锁相。 - **圆桨胸鳍同理。** 三角形鳍只能画出细长条或长条，`paddle` 用「前缘 + 弦长」按跨距参数化，才能画出圆头的桨叶。实测外露约 5 格，一眼能看见。 - **整体半透明。** 默认 0.6，设置里可调 0.1–1。透明度作用在 canvas 上而不是逐个颜色上，所以网格、尾迹、鱼和虎鲸是同一个系数一起淡下去的，虎鲸才像在水里，而不是浮在水前面。 - **跟着 shell 的明暗走。** 暗色下是亮块挖暗字，亮色下是淡灰底压深字。切主题时海洋当场换色，不用刷新。 - **不开着不干活的循环。** 离屏停、切标签页停、`prefers-reduced-motion` 下只画一帧、DPR 封顶 2、固定 1/60 步长最多补 4 帧。 ## 装 ```sh sh scripts/install.sh # 默认接进 desktop profile sh scripts/install.sh --profile=web ``` 然后**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（宿主启动时才扫描插件清单）。 装完： - 新建会话页的背景就是这片海； - `设置` 左侧导航里多一个 **「ASCII 海洋」** 页：顶部是运行状态（正在运行 / 已暂停 / 已关闭 / 系统要求减弱动效），下面依次是透明度、浓淡、**数量（1–5）**、整群种类（含**随机**）、鼠标驱鱼。 - `设置 → 通用设置` 里也有一行快捷开关（透明度、浓淡、物种、鼠标驱鱼）。 > **为什么侧栏「插件」页里看不到它？** 那一页只列 DSH 自己的官方 bundle（`@deepseek-ai/*` 的固定名单），第三方客户端插件不在其中 —— `dsh-visualize`、`dsh-computer-use` 同样不在。`设置 → 内置插件` 那份只读清单列的是各 Agent 预设内部挂的插件，顶层挂载的第三方包也不在里面。所以「设置 → ASCII 海洋」这一页就是它在 DSH 里唯一能被按名字找到的地方，这一页正是为此加的。 默认是 **3 头虎鲸**在不同深度巡游，整体透明度 0.72。数量可在 1–5 之间调。 游速比原版慢：鲸鱼巡航降到 0.58 倍（约 2.4 格/秒），冲刺倍率也从 1.45 收到 1.25；鱼群 0.82 倍 —— 鱼小，同样的像素速度看起来慢得多，减太多会显得停住。 摘除： ```sh sh scripts/install.sh --uninstall ``` 偏好存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-ascii-sharks:v1`），不写进 Host 的设置文档——这是每窗口的视觉口味，不该跨机器同步。 ## 开发 ```sh npm install npm run verify # 类型检查 + 构建 Host 半区 + 构建浏览器半区 npm run preview # 生成 preview/harness.js open preview/index.html # 带 sidebar/hero/composer 的模拟页 open preview/lab.html # 外形实验室：八种鲨鱼并排，静止 open preview/parity.html # 与上游原版同条件（整屏、四条 classic） ``` `preview/` 是开发用的，不进发布包。 ### 结构 ``` src/ index.ts Host 半区：只发布默认值，其余留空（见下） entry.ts 浏览器半区入口：注册两个座位，没有渲染逻辑 surface.tsx 海洋座位：把 canvas 挂进会话列 settings-row.tsx 设置行（总开关 / 透明度 / 浓淡 / 物种 / 鼠标驱鱼） store.ts 共享配置 store（localStorage 后备） engine.ts 固定步长循环、resize、指针、透明度、离屏暂停 world.ts 鱼群与虎鲸/鲨鱼的行为模拟 renderer.ts 逐格字符光栅化 shapes.ts 九种外形函数（八种鲨鱼 + 虎鲸） species.ts 五种鱼的行为参数表 math.ts clamp / 角度差 / 哈希噪声 / 无散度海流 ``` ### 三个必须知道的约束 1. **浏览器半区必须是一个自包含的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load()` 调用。** loader 给的 `require` 只认 shell 已经种进平台表的模块（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`），解析不了本地路径。所以 `scripts/build-client.mjs` 用 esbuild 把引擎打成一个 CommonJS bundle 再套上 loader 信封。React 必须留在 external——打进第二份 React 会让组件拿到另一个 hook dispatcher，每个 hook 都炸。 2. **canvas 挂在会话列里，不挂 `shell.overlay`。** overlay 是 `z-index: 20` 的整框浮层、在每一列之上；把背景画在那儿会盖住内容。挂进列里、给 canvas `z-index: -1` 配 `isolation: isolate`，才是「列底色之上、所有内容之下」——层级是诚实的，不用跟浮层打架。 3. **文案字典要在 `ctx.inject(["locale"], …)` 里注册。** 冷启动时这个 bundle 比 locale 插件先激活，`ctx.get("locale")` 会答 undefined；一次性 `ctx.effect` 在那儿放弃，整个页面生命周期内 namespace 都不会注册，症状是每个标签都渲染成自己的 key。 ## 来源 引擎逻辑、行为参数与外形比例移植自 [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)（TypeScript，零依赖）。 上游仓库**当时没有 LICENSE 文件**，issue #1「Missing license」还开着。所以本仓库也**不提供许可证** —— 移植进来的部分我没有权利授权给你，原创部分我也选择不授权。想合法复用，先找上游作者。 改动清单： - 去掉上游的黑底与固定网格画布，改成透明背景 + 自适应主题； - 上游把鲨鱼活动区绕开居中的标题椭圆，这里改成绕开由宿主测量的 hero 区域（侧栏展开时内容列不是居中的）； - 新增虎鲸外形与白眼斑/鞍斑（`FLAG_PALE`），并新增整体透明度（作用在 canvas 合成层上）； - 上游 `base.css` 之外还画了一圈环境点阵，这里去掉——在 DSH 里它和宿主的字符网格打架； - 指针输入、离屏暂停、可见性暂停、`prefers-reduced-motion` 全部接到宿主生命周期上； - 新增配置 store、设置行、locale 字典。

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-sync 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）做的**会话云同步**：自部署服务端、端到端加密，同步会话与附件；设备台账、agent 笔记与多工作区映射见 [docs/VAULT.md](docs/VAULT.md) 设计稿。 > **状态：M1/M2 已完成，M3 已完成，M4 进行中。** 帧工具/加密、服务端（含管理台与初始化）、M0 免重启 ingest 已经可跑；M3 的推送/拉取、安全边界、双 home E2E、durable journal 与错误退避已通过。M4 已完成 A1–A5、B1–B5（凭据、设置页、首启向导）、C1–C4/C6（composer block、列表拦截、行标记、同步气泡）与 E1（`batches` 规范字段）；剩 C5 GUI 回归、D5 故障文案演练与 E3 文档收口。里程碑见 [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md)。 ## 支持版本 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2-0`。0.2.1 之前缺少本插件依赖的能力（如 `appendPluginRecord`），不做兼容。 ## 目录 ``` packages/shared/ 帧处理（多帧 zstd）、端到端加密、线上类型；插件与服务端共用 packages/plugin/ DSH 宿主插件（install_bundle 的目标目录） packages/server/ 自部署服务端：node:http + node:sqlite + blob 目录，零运行时依赖 tests/ 临时 DSH home 的硬约束与夹具（见 tests/README.md） docs/ 设计、协议 ``` ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm test # node --test（.ts 由 Node 24 直接运行） pnpm typecheck pnpm check # typecheck + test pnpm fixtures # 重新生成夹具的 .zstd 兄弟文件 pnpm dev:server # 在 .tmp/dev-data 起服务端（127.0.0.1:8787） pnpm dev:dsh # 起隔离的 DSH 开发实例（默认端口 3090） pnpm dev:console # 起 M0 控制台（127.0.0.1:3091，见 tests/m0/README.md） ``` 夹具由官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 校验器验证（`packages/shared` 的 devDependencies，版本与 DSH 对齐）。 **首次启动服务端**：控制台会打印一次性初始化密钥，并提示打开 ；按向导设置管理密码、存储配额，可选创建第一台设备。之后管理台用密码登录；忘记密码执行 `node packages/server/src/index.ts admin reset`（重启后重新打印初始化密钥）。 ### 隔离的 DSH 开发实例 `pnpm dev:dsh` 会： - 把 `DSH_HOME` 指到 `.tmp/dev-dsh/home`； - 用 `--patch` 覆盖 `workspace-controller` 的 `documentsDirectory`，让**默认工作区**落在 `.tmp/dev-dsh/documents/`（否则 DSH 会建到系统 Documents 下）； - 清掉从当前会话继承的 `DSH_*` 变量，避免新实例误以为自己在嵌套运行。 需要保留已登录状态时：`node scripts/dev-dsh.mjs --credentials <旧 home 的 .credentials.yaml>`。脚本拒绝在 `.tmp/` 之外创建实例目录。 ## 两条硬约定 - **测试绝不碰真实 `~/.dsh`**：所有临时 home 经 `tests/helpers/tmp-home.mjs` 创建，位于 `.tmp/` 且被 git 忽略；规则与断言清单见 [tests/README.md](tests/README.md)。 - **仓库文档写我们的选择与中性事实**，不评价其他项目。 ## 文档 - [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md)：M0–M4 里程碑、当前状态与文档地图。 - [docs/M4-PLAN.md](docs/M4-PLAN.md)：M4 工作项、依赖顺序与待拍板项。 - [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)：范围、数据分层、并发与加密的取舍。 - [docs/VAULT.md](docs/VAULT.md)：加密附加数据层、多工作区映射、设备台账与插件版本匹配（设计稿）。 - [docs/CWD.md](docs/CWD.md)：cwd/工作目录事件处理：header canonical、事件 raw、接收端修正。 - [docs/DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md)：cwd/Canonical 反复讨论后的最终决策记录。 - [docs/PROMPT-GUIDANCE.md](docs/PROMPT-GUIDANCE.md)：agent 提示词规划：尽量不把会话 cwd 切到工作区外。 - [docs/RECONCILE.md](docs/RECONCILE.md)：会话身份、raw 前缀校验、默认自动同步与冲突/忽略流程。 - [docs/GLOSSARY.md](docs/GLOSSARY.md)：术语表（Canonical、生命周期、workspaceKey、对账等）。 - [docs/USAGE-AGREEMENT.md](docs/USAGE-AGREEMENT.md)：使用协议草案（修改边界、加密边界、风险告知）。 - [docs/PROTOCOL.md](docs/PROTOCOL.md)：服务端端点与不变量。 - [docs/SYNC-SAFETY.md](docs/SYNC-SAFETY.md)：开放尾与安全边界、拉取原子性、客户端防误操作。 - [docs/UI-GUIDELINES.md](docs/UI-GUIDELINES.md)：客户端页面的动效与可访问性约定。 - [dev/ui/README.md](dev/ui/README.md)：设置页 / 首启 / 同步气泡的静态原型。 - [tests/README.md](tests/README.md)：临时 home 与夹具约定。 ## 许可证 本仓库按目录拆分许可： - **`packages/server/**`：AGPL-3.0-only**（[全文](LICENSES/AGPL-3.0-only.txt)）。对外提供修改后的服务端时，需按 AGPL §13 向使用者提供对应源码；个人自部署、仅自己使用不受影响。 - **`packages/plugin/**`、`packages/shared/**` 及其余部分：MIT**（[全文](LICENSES/MIT.txt)）。 根目录的 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 是拆分范围的简短说明；各 package 目录下也各有一份对应全文。

# dsh-control-center

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Three visual Settings pages for the DeepSeek Harness: **MCP servers**, **skills**
and **global personas**. One dual-face plugin — a host half that owns the data
and the one model-facing contribution, and a browser half that renders the
pages into the settings shell.

> The Chinese document ([README.zh.md](README.zh.md)) is the fuller one: it adds
> the verification log, troubleshooting, and the one-click script reference.

```
Settings
├── …
├── MCP 管理          MCP server CRUD
├── Skill 管理        author or pull skills, inspect and delete them
└── 全局人设          a library of persona documents, one active
```

## Install

The package is a normal DSH bundle. Any channel works.

**One script (Windows).** Copies the package, backs the patch up once, and
writes the marked mount block — idempotent, `-DryRun` to preview, `-Profile` /
`-DshHome` to target another profile:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\uninstall.ps1   # one-key restore
```

**Official CLI**, which also records the bundle in the profile manifest:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-control-center
```

**By hand**, for a profile whose `node_modules` is managed manually: copy this
directory to `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-control-center`, then append the mount
row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: control-center
      name: 'dsh-control-center'
```

`dsh-hmr` watches that file, so the plugin activates on save; the browser half
is part of the client boot graph and needs one page refresh the first time it
appears. After the first installation the script leaves
`cordis.patch.yml.bak-dsh-control-center` as the final rollback point.

## The three pages

### MCP 管理

An MCP server is a Loader row, not a settings value, so the page writes a
delimited **managed block** into the active profile's own patch layer and lets
`dsh-hmr` reload the composition:

```yaml
# >>> dsh-control-center:mcp — managed, edit it from Settings instead
- insert: [{"id":"cc-mcp-github","name":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client","config":{…}}]
# <<< dsh-control-center:mcp
```

Everything outside the two markers is preserved byte for byte, and the payload
is JSON — a strict subset of YAML 1.2 — so no URL, argument or environment value
can change the document's shape. The definitions live in
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/mcp-servers.json`; the block is regenerated from them
on every write, so disabling a server removes its row without losing it.

The row reports its live Loader state, so the list distinguishes *configured*,
*enabled* and *connected*.

### Skill 管理

Skills are ordinary files, so this page is a filesystem editor over the roots
`dsh-skill-filesystem` already scans — it keeps no database:

| Root | Source |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/skills` | `user-dsh`, provider rank 400 — where installs go |
| `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` | `user-agents`, rank 500 |
| any `customSkillDirs` | from a live `skill-filesystem` row |

Project roots (`.dsh/skills`, `.agents/skills`) depend on the session's working
directory rather than on this global page and are deliberately left out.

* **New skill** writes `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` with `name`, `description`,
  `whenToUse` and the body.
* **Raw editor** opens the current file verbatim; saving re-validates the
  frontmatter.
* **Pull from GitHub** downloads one source archive, finds every `SKILL.md` at a
  plausible depth, and installs each bundle. Three URL shapes are accepted, plus
  the `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` spelling:

  ```
  https://github.com/owner/repo
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>/<subpath>
  ```

  No `git` binary is needed: the archive is fetched from `codeload` and unpacked
  by a small built-in tar reader. An existing skill is only replaced when
  **overwrite** is on.

The filesystem provider watches its roots, so a created, edited or deleted skill
reaches the next model step without a restart.

### 全局人设

Each persona is a Markdown document under
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/personas/`, with its name and description in
`personas.json`. Exactly one is active, and the page can clear the seat.

The active document is registered as **one** system-prompt section:

```js
ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: 'control-center:persona',
  order: 5,
  text: activeDocument,
  interpolate: false,
})
```

Three properties follow, and all are intended:

* **additive** — the harness identity, the deployment persona, tool guidance and
  the environment suffix are untouched; the section lands immediately after the
  deployment persona prefix at order 0;
* **global** — a preset that shadows `deployment:persona-prefix` for one agent
  does not remove it, so every session is covered;
* **literal** — `interpolate: false` keeps `{{…}}` as written, so a stray brace
  in prose can never fail prompt assembly.

Switching the active document disposes and re-registers the section; the next
assembly carries the new text.

## HTTP API

One POST-only route, `/control-center/api`, with a `method` field:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `system.info` | paths and version |
| `mcp.state` / `mcp.save` / `mcp.remove` / `mcp.toggle` | MCP servers |
| `skill.state` / `skill.read` / `skill.save` / `skill.write` / `skill.remove` / `skill.pull` | skills |
| `persona.state` / `persona.read` / `persona.save` / `persona.remove` / `persona.activate` | personas |

Responses are `{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`.
The route is fenced against cross-origin browser callers: an `Origin` header must
name a loopback host, and a present `Content-Type` must be JSON. A caller with no
`Origin` — the Electron IPC bridge, a shell tool — is already running with the
user's own authority.

## Checks

Both scripts need no dependencies and no harness:

```bash
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs     # host half: frontmatter, tar, the managed block, all three stores over real files
node scripts/clientsmoke.mjs   # browser half: bundle, slot registration, every section rendered with stubbed host replies
```

`skill.pull`'s network path is not exercised by either; verify it against a real
repository from the running harness.

## Layout

```
index.js                 host half: route, API table, persona section, MCP reconciliation
client.js                browser half: the three Settings sections
lib/wire.js              body reader, JSON responder, request fence
lib/paths.js             DSH_HOME / profile locations, atomic read-write
lib/mcp.js               MCP store + the managed patch block
lib/skills.js            skill roots, frontmatter, CRUD, GitHub install
lib/github.js            repository reference parsing + archive download
lib/tar.js               minimal tar reader
lib/personas.js          persona store + the prompt section lifecycle
scripts/install.ps1      one-key install (UTF-8 with BOM — see README.zh.md)
scripts/uninstall.ps1    one-key restore
scripts/selfcheck.mjs    host-half checks
scripts/clientsmoke.mjs  browser-half checks
```

## Publishing to the DSH plugin market

`package.json` is already shaped for it (no `private`, `license`, `repository`
with `directory`, `keywords`, `engines.dsh`, `peerDependencies`,
`dsh.manifestVersion`) and `locale/{en,zh}.json` supplies the store card copy.

The catalog is the curated list [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin):
add ONE file under `data/plugins/`, run `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs`, open
a PR. The step-by-step checklist — plus the entry YAML, a pre-flight validator
and the screenshot template — lives in the repository's `publish/` directory.

# dsh-dd-forge — due-diligence document review (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

**Documents → rule packs → risk report**: feed the deterministic engine a due-diligence folder (registry / equity / financials / contracts / charters / employment contracts) and get a sourced risk report. Built for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/DeepSeek-AI/deepseek-harness); the engine (opcore) itself has zero dsh dependencies and runs standalone.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh session (model + judgement)                  │
│   skills: dsh-dd-forge-review / -report          │  ← judgement layer (prompt skills)
│   tools:  dd_review / dd_rules                   │  ← deterministic layer (registered tools)
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ opcore engine (engine/, zero dsh deps)           │
│   loader (docs → facts) → rule execution → report │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ packs/ (YAML rule packs — data, not code)        │
│   general-company 12 · contract-basics 8         │
│   trade-contract 8 · trade-bulk 10               │
│   logistics 8 · labour 8 · credit-financials 8   │
│   guarantee 5 · corporate-charter 5              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-dd-forge
```

Local development: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-dd-forge` — pnpm `link:` installs do not auto-install dependencies, so run `npm install` in this directory first.

## Use

In a dsh session, hand a target folder to the model ("run a due-diligence review on ./target-company"), or call the tools directly:

- **`dd_review`** — run all rule packs over a folder (the `packs` parameter optionally narrows to a pack subset); returns findings and writes the report into the workspace (`reportPath` overrides the report location); the `format` parameter selects `md` / `docx` / `xlsx` (comma-separated, default `md`); the top-up loop parameters are `saveRun` (serialize this run into a re-runnable review.json snapshot) and `baseline` (diff against a previous snapshot — see "Top-up re-run loop"); pass a `targets` array to review several folders in one call (see "Batch review")
- **`dd_rules`** — list packs and every rule with severity, category, and public reference

Skills: `dsh-dd-forge-review` (folder conventions + verification discipline for high findings), `dsh-dd-forge-report` (writing the full DD report on top of engine output).

### Batch review (several folders)

To review several subjects in one session, `dd_review` takes a `targets` array (mutually exclusive with `target`): `targets=["./companyA","./companyB"]`. Each folder gets its own report set (exported per `format` as `<workspace>/dd-review-report-<company>.<ext>`; the folder name when no registry document names the subject; duplicates get `-2`/`-3` suffixes), plus one **summary index** at `<workspace>/dd-review-index.md` (`indexPath` overrides the location): a per-subject conclusion/stats table, a cross-subject high-severity quick view, totals, and relative links to every report — closed by the same disclaimer.

Every folder is validated up front (one inaccessible folder fails the whole call — no half delivery). `reportPath` / `saveRun` / `baseline` are single-run parameters and are rejected with `targets` — to take one folder through the top-up loop, call the tool with `target` for it alone.

### Folder conventions

The engine recognizes documents by filename patterns; anything missing simply leaves the corresponding rules as `missing_data`:

| Document | File | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registry | `工商信息.json` (or any json matching 工商/registry) | Chinese or English keys; capital in 万元 |
| Equity | `*股权*.csv` or `.xlsx` (filename/sheet matching 股权/股东) | header: 股东,认缴出资(万元),实缴出资(万元),持股比例(%),备注 |
| Financials | `*资产负债*.csv`, `*利润*.csv`, `*现金流量*.csv` (or same-named xlsx sheets) | accounts as rows, years as columns (`科目,2024,2023`), 万元 |
| Contracts | `contracts/*.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | one contract per file; optional frontmatter: 标题, 签订日期 |
| Charter | any `章程`-matching `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | extracts company name, registered capital, shareholder rows, mandatory items, share-transfer clause |
| Employment contract | any `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` whose filename contains 「劳动合同」 or whose body contains 「劳动合同期限」 | extracts contract term, probation months and its statutory tiered cap, probation/agreed salary, non-compete term and compensation, service period with training cost and penalty, mandatory items and rules-policy wording |

docx (contracts/charters) and xlsx (financials/equity) are parsed **natively** (mammoth/exceljs, lazily loaded — zero cost when absent). Only scans/images need in-session conversion first.

The loader also extracts clause facts from contract bodies for the specialized packs: **deposit amount and ratio** ("定金…N 元"), **advance amount and ratio** (amount form "预付款 N 元" or percent form "预付 N%", feeding the bulk-trade pack), **payment term days** ("N 日内付清/支付" — deadlines that pay a deposit/advance do not count; read by both the trade and logistics packs), **daily penalty rate** ("万分之X/日", auto-annualized), **trade-contract classification** (购销/买卖/采购/销售/供货/大宗商品/贸易 — bulk-trade rules report 不适用 on non-trade contracts), **logistics-contract classification** (货物运输/运输服务/承运/仓储/配送 — logistics rules report 不适用 on non-logistics contracts; a counterparty *named* 「物流」 does not classify a contract), plus 36 clause-presence probes (risk transfer, force majeure, notice, acceptance, exclusivity, third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-vs-penalty election, documents of title, auto-renewal, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related & dispute institution, cargo damage liability, insured/declared-value carriage, loading duties, subcontracting restrictions, POD & reconciliation, cargo claims, vehicle & driver qualifications, …).

Employment contracts are parsed as their own document type (they never enter the commercial-contract candidate set): **contract term in years** (date form 「劳动合同期限自 X 起至 Y 止」 first, stated years as fallback; open-ended contracts detected separately), **probation months with the statutory tiered cap** (Labour Contract Law art. 19 tiers: <3 months 0 / 3 months-1 year 1 / 1-3 years 2 / ≥3 years & open-ended 6), **probation vs agreed salary** (auto-derived 80%-line ratio), **non-compete term** (months/years normalized) **and compensation clause** (an explicit 「无需支付经济补偿」 waiver does not count as agreed), **service period with training cost and penalty**, plus art.-17 mandatory-item and rules-policy probes.

## Rule packs

Nine packs, 72 rules, each with a public reference (statute or an explicitly labelled convention threshold):

| Pack | Rules | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `general-company` | 12 | registry status, paid-in ratio, equity cross-checks, balance-sheet identity & solvency, guarantee resolutions |
| `contract-basics` | 8 | essential clauses, digit-vs-uppercase amounts, signing date and signature block |
| `trade-contract` | 8 | deposit cap (Civ. Code art. 586, 20%), payment term (90-day convention), risk transfer, force majeure, daily penalty annualized |
| `trade-bulk` | 10 | bulk-trade special: advance ratio (30% convention), third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-plus-penalty election (Civ. Code art. 588), force majeure excluding market swings, documents of title (仓单/提单), auto-renewal exit, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related dispute institution |
| `logistics` | 8 | logistics special: cargo damage/loss liability (Civ. Code art. 832), insured/declared-value carriage, freight payment term (60-day convention reading the same fact as TC-002's 90-day line — layered thresholds), loading duties, subcontracting restrictions (cf. art. 923), POD & reconciliation, cargo-claim procedure & deadline, vehicle & driver qualifications |
| `labour` | 8 | employment special: mandatory clauses (Labour Contract Law art. 17), probation tiered cap and 80% salary line (arts. 19/20), non-compete compensation and two-year cap (arts. 23/24), servi

plugins.readme_text:
# 🐱 anime-pet-widget — DSH 二次元宠物陪伴插件

> 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面 **右下角** 的小宠物「小窝兽」。
> 它会**根据 Agent 状态做出不同反应**，并用 Web Audio **实时合成声音**——
> 当任务完成时，它会高高兴兴地唱出一段完成琶音。🎉

这是一个类型为 **动态 Cordis 插件（Dynamic Cordis Plugin）** 的项目：它临时挂载到当前 DSH 进程，
不修改任何仓库源码或配置，卸载时自动清理所有副作用。仓库中的 `host.js` 与 `client.js`
即插件的两半（Host 半 + Client 半），可直接交给 DSH 的 `cordis_define` 工具加载。

---

## ✨ 功能特性

| 特性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 📌 右下角常驻 | 挂在 `shell.overlay` 全局浮层，`position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 20px`，位于所有栏位之上 |
| 🐾 可爱形象 | 粉色渐变胶囊里一只小猫 🐱，带呼吸 / 工作跳动 / 庆祝 / 难过的 CSS 动画 |
| 💬 状态气泡 | 实时显示当前状态文案（等主人 / 努力工作中 / 完成啦 / 出错了） |
| 🔊 不同声音 | 根据 Agent 状态切换：**开始音**、**完成音**、**出错音** |
| 🎵 实时合成 | 用 Web Audio（`AudioContext` + 振荡器）现场合成三个音效，**无需任何音频文件**、无网络请求 |
| ✅ 任务完成提示 | 监听 `idle ⇄ running` 切换，在 `running → idle` 时播放"完成任务"的 do-mi-sol-do 琶音 |
| 🔇 一键静音 | 胶囊上的 🔊 / 🔇 按钮可随时开关声音 |
| 🧹 自动清理 | 所有监听 / 处理器 / 定时器 / 样式均归属当前 Cordis Fiber，停止或更新插件时一并移除 |

---

## 🔧 工作原理

### 架构总览

```
                ┌───────────────────────────  DSH 主机进程  ───────────────────────────────┐
                │  host.js (Host 半)                                                       │
                │                                                                            │
                │   ctx.on('agent/status')  ─── idle ⇄ running ──┐                          │
                │   ctx.on('agent/error')   ─── errored ────────┤                          │
                │                                                ▼                          │
                │                                     { status, errored } ← 纯标量快照      │
                │                                                │                          │
                │                 harness.handle('anime-pet:status')  ◀───── 轮询           │
                └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                            ▲  host.call (JSON RPC, Client→Host)
                                            │
                ┌───────────────────────────  浏览器页面  ───────────────────────────────────┐
                │  client.js (Client 半)                                                    │
                │                                                                            │
                │   styles.insert(css)  ───── 注入样式                                       │
                │   slots.register('shell.overlay', id:'anime-pet')  ── 右下角渲染            │
                │   AudioFX 合成器  ──── 开始/完成/出错 三音效                              │
                └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 用到的 DSH 能力（全部通过 Inspect Provider 查询确认）

- **Host 事件** `agent/status`：Agent 状态变化 `idle ⇄ running`——这是触发"开始工作"与"任务完成"声的关键。
- **Host 事件** `agent/error`：某一步或某轮出错——宠物据此播放"抱歉"音并显示 😿。
- **Host Builtin** `harness.handle`：注册插件私有的 JSON 处理器，供 Client 侧 `host.call` 调用。
- **Client Slot** `shell.overlay`：全窗口浮层（frame-wide，位于所有柱 / 滚动容器之外，默认点击穿透、由条目自行开启 pointer-events）。
- **Client Service** `timer`：`ctx.interval`（每 650ms 轮询状态）与 `ctx.timeout`（完成/出错后延时恢复）。
- **Client Builtin** `styles.insert` / `host.call` / `React`：注入样式、调用 Host、构建 UI。

### 状态机

| Agent 状态 | 宠物表现 | 音效 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | 小猫 🐱 缓慢呼吸，"主人，我在等你哦～" | 无 |
| `running` | 上下跳动，"努力工作中！加油！" | 开始音（柔和的上升“咕”音） |
| `running → idle`（任务完成） | 庆祝动画 🎉，"完成啦！🎉" | **完成音**（do-mi-sol-do 琶音） |
| 出错 | 😿 晃动，"唔…刚刚出错了…" | 偏低沉的"抱歉"音 |

> 说明：浏览器默认禁止在用户与页面交互前自动播放声音。插件在页面**第一次 `pointerdown`** 时
> 调用 `AudioContext.resume()` 解锁音频——所以在页面里随便点一下，声音即可正常响起。

---

## 📦 安装与运行（在 DSH 中加载）

本插件是**运行时动态插件**，无需全局安装或改动仓库：

1. 打开 DSH Web 界面，进入一个会话。
2. 让 Agent 调用 `cordis_define` 工具，并传入 `dist/cordis-package.json` 的内容（可由下方脚本生成）。
3. 用 `cordis_run` 激活该 Package（`mode: "run"`），Client 半会弹出**授权请求**——点击"允许/批准"。
4. 刷新或直接观察页面右下角，小窝兽就会出现。

### 一键生成 `dist/cordis-package.json`

```bash
node scripts/build-package.mjs
```

该脚本读取 `host.js` + `client.js`，输出可直接粘贴进 `cordis_define` 的 JSON。

### 手动加载（示意）

`cordis_define` 的 `code.host` 与 `code.client` 分别是两个**普通 JavaScript 函数体**（非 TS / 非 JSX）：

- `code.host` ← 取自 `host.js` 的 `return { apply(ctx) { … } }`
- `code.client` ← 取自 `client.js` 的 `return { inject, apply(ctx) { … } }`

两个半区各自在对应平台运行，并共享同一个 `pluginId` / `packageId`。

---

## 🎛️ 使用说明

- **静音 / 开启声音**：点击胶囊上的 🔊 或 🔇。
- **解锁声音**：任何一次页面点击即可（自动播放策略所致）。
- **更换宠物名**：编辑器里改 `AnimePet` 组件中的 `'小窝兽'`。
- **更换形象**：改 `.pet-face` 里的 emoji（见"自定义"）。

---

## 🎨 自定义

### 改形象（emoji）

在 `client.js` 的 `AnimePet` 组件中修改 `face`：

```js
const face =
  phase === 'done'
    ? status === 'running' ? '✨' : '🎉'
    : phase === 'error' ? '😿' : '🐱';   // ← 把 🐱 换成 🐰 / 🐹 / 🦊 / 🐶 …
```

### 改配色 / 动画

颜色在 `PET_CSS` 中：

```css
.pet-body {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd6e7, #d6e4ff);  /* ← 胶囊渐变 */
}
.pet-bubble { border: 2px solid #ffd6e7; }               /* ← 气泡边框 */
```

### 改声音（Web Audio 音高 / 旋律 / 强弱）

所有合成都集中在 `AudioFX`，例如完成音是五音上行琶音：

```js
complete: () => {
  tone(523.25, 0,    0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // do
  tone(659.25, 0.14, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // mi
  tone(783.99, 0.28, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // sol
  tone(1046.5, 0.42, 0.34, 'triangle', 0.2);   // do' (高)
  tone(1318.5, 0.48, 0.3,  'sine',     0.1);   // 亮泛音
}
```

---

## 📁 目录结构

```
anime-pet-widget/
├─ host.js                     # Host 半：监听 Agent 状态，提供 RPC（status/errored）
├─ client.js                   # Client 半：右下角渲染 + Web Audio 合成 + 状态轮询
├─ scripts/
│  └─ build-package.mjs        # 读取 host.js/client.js → 输出 cordis_define 载荷
├─ package.json                # 项目元数据（DSH 插件，非 npm 发布包）
├─ LICENSE                     # MIT
├─ .gitignore
└─ README.md
```

---

## 🔬 技术细节

- **没有音频文件、没有网络请求**：三个音效全部由 `AudioContext` 的 `OscillatorNode` + `GainNode` 实时合成，体积最小、最可控。
- **JSON 边界严格**：Host 与 Client 只通过 `host.call` 传递 `{ status: 'idle'|'running', errored: boolean }` 这类纯标量，绝不序列化任何 Service / Session / Agent 存活对象。
- **副作用可逆**：`ctx.on`、`harness.handle`、`ctx.interval`、`ctx.timeout`、`styles.insert` 全部由当前 Fiber 持有；`cordis_stop` / `cordis_update` / `cordis_undefine` 会一次性清理。
- **仅使用纯 JS**：两端都不使用 TS / JSX / import；UI 用 `React.createElement` 构建。
- **轮询而非长连接**：Client 每 650ms 调用一次 `host.call('anime-pet:status')`，足以捕捉空闲↔运行切换，成本极低。

---

## ⚠️ 兼容性与注意事项

- 依赖 **DSH 动态 Cordis 插件运行时**（`cordis_define` / `cordis_run` 工具）。若你的 Harness 版本没有这些工具，本插件无法加载。
- 声音需要**浏览器支持 Web Audio**（现代 Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari 均可）。
- 自动播放依赖用户与页面的一次交互；若完全无人操作页面则不会出声（动画与文案不受影响）。

---

## 📄 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)

---

## 🙏 关于

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）开发的一个小玩具，欢迎 fork / 改造成你自己的专属宠物。
如果你给它加了可爱的新形象或好听的音效，欢迎提 PR 分享～ 🐾

---

## 🇬🇧 English

**anime-pet-widget** is a Dynamic Cordis Plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It renders a kawaii pet pinned to the **bottom-right** of the web GUI and reacts to the Agent state with **synthesized sounds** (Web Audio, no assets needed). When a task finishes (`running → idle`), the pet plays a cheerful completion arpeggio.

**How to load:** hand `dist/cordis-package.json` (from `node scripts/build-package.mjs`) to the DSH `cordis_define` tool, then `cordis_run` it and approve the Client authorization.

**Files:** `host.js` (Host half — listens to `agent/status` / `agent/error`, serves `{ status, errored }` over `harness.handle`), `client.js` (Client half — mounts in the `shell.overlay` slot, polls every 650 ms via `host.call`, and synthesizes start/complete/error sounds). License: MIT.

# django-generic-websocket-project
a generic websocket  
一个非常通用的websocket项目  

# Install
```bash
# 默认使用内存 channel layer，不需要 redis server
git clone git@github.com:ramwin/django-generic-websocket-project.git
cd django-generic-websocket-project
pip3 install -r ./requirements.txt
```

# channel layer（默认不需要 redis）
默认 `CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=memory`（见 `.env.shared`），消息在**当前进程内**广播：
不需要 redis 服务，也不需要 `channels_redis`，`python3 manage.py runserver 7420` 直接就能跑。

多实例部署（`deploy/supervisor.conf` 的 3 个 daphne、docker compose 扩副本）**必须**换成 redis，
否则实例 A 推送的消息，连在实例 B 上的客户端收不到：
```bash
# .env 或 .env.shared（.env 优先级更高）
CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=redis
WEBSOCKET_REDIS_HOST=localhost
WEBSOCKET_REDIS_PORT=6379
```
```bash
pip3 install channels_redis   # 需要同时安装这个包
```
其他说明：
- 启动了 memory 后端时，服务启动日志里会有一条 WARNING 提醒单进程限制
- 配置值只能是 `memory` 或 `redis`，写错了启动时会直接报 `ImproperlyConfigured`
- 项目里 `.env` / `.env.shared` 的优先级**高于**进程环境变量，Docker 的 `environment` 覆盖不生效

# Usage
```
# in terminal 1
python3 manage.py runserver 7420

# in terminal 2
python3 test_send_message.py

# in terminal 3
python3 test_receive_message.py
```

# 浏览器里查看会话
```bash
# 终端 1：启动服务
python3 manage.py runserver 7420

# 浏览器打开（房间名跟推送时用的房间名保持一致）
# http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/room/room_123/

# 终端 2：用 HTTP 接口往这个房间推消息，页面上会立刻出现
curl -X POST http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/send-message/room_123/ \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{"message": "hello"}'
```
- 页面里的输入框也可以发消息，会通过 WebSocket 广播给房间内的所有客户端
- 消息格式不限：有 `message` 字段就显示这个文本，其余字段以 JSON 附在下面；没有 `message` 字段就整体格式化输出
- 需要鉴权时把 token 放在页面地址上，会透传给 WebSocket：`http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/room/room_123/?token=token123`
- 房间名只能包含字母/数字/下划线（和 WebSocket 路由 `(?P<room_name>\w+)` 一致）
- 连接断开（比如服务重启）后页面会指数退避自动重连
- 页面模板：`generic/templates/generic/room.html`，HTML 和 JS 全部内联，不依赖静态文件服务

# Deploy
1. change `project/settings.py`
```
DEBUG = False
ALLOWED_HOSTS = [<your hostname>]
```

2. run command
```
replace example.com with your hostname
daphne -b <example.com> -p <port> wsbackend.asgi:application
```

# load balance
1. use `deploy/supervisor.conf` to run multi instance
2. use `deploy/nginx/websocket.ramwin.com` to loadbalance
3. 多实例必须设置 `CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=redis` 并安装 `channels_redis`，否则跨实例收不到消息
